It is an evaluation paper, not a model-architecture paper.

title: PuLID: Pure and Lightning ID Customization via Contrastive Alignment
summary: A tuning-free ID customization method for text-to-image diffusion that adds a Lightning fast-sampling T2I branch during training, using contrastive alignment of UNet features (with vs. without ID insertion) plus an accurate ID loss computed on the fast-sampled x0, achieving high ID fidelity with minimal disruption to the base model's behavior (paraphrase of Sections 1, 3.4-3.6).

title: XFeat: Accelerated Features for Lightweight Image Matching
summary: XFeat (per the paper) is a lightweight CNN for local feature extraction that performs keypoint detection, 64-D descriptor extraction, reliability estimation, and semi-dense match refinement, designed for fast CPU/embedded inference via early downsampling with few channels and a parallel keypoint branch.

title: Extending Llama-3's Context Ten-Fold Overnight
summary: A QLoRA fine-tuning recipe that extends Llama-3-8B-Instruct's context from 8K to 80K using only ~3.5K GPT-4-synthesized long-context samples (plus RedPajama and LongAlpaca mixes), with an enlarged RoPE base (500K to 200M), trained in 8 hours on 8xA800.

title: KAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
summary: Proposes Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs), which replace fixed node activations and linear weights of MLPs with learnable univariate B-spline activation functions on edges, showing better accuracy, scaling, and interpretability than MLPs on small-scale scientific tasks (paper claim).

title: StoryDiffusion: Consistent Self-Attention for Long-Range Image and Video Generation
summary: A training-free Consistent Self-Attention that samples tokens across a batch of images in a pretrained diffusion U-Net to keep characters consistent, plus a Semantic Motion Predictor (CLIP-encoded semantic-space transformer) trained with MSE on Webvid10M to interpolate transition frames decoded by a video diffusion model.

title: AniTalker: Animate Vivid and Diverse Talking Faces through Identity-Decoupled Facial Motion Encoding
summary: A two-stage talking-face framework: (1) self-supervised universal facial motion representation learning with identity decoupling via metric learning (AAM-Softmax), mutual information minimization (CLUB), and a Hierarchical Aggregation Layer; (2) speech-driven motion latent generation with a diffusion model (Conformer-based, DDPM training / DDIM sampling) plus a variance adapter, rendered frame-by-frame by a warp-based renderer.

title: Mirage: A Multi-Level Superoptimizer for Tensor Programs
summary: Mirage is a superoptimizer for GPU tensor programs that uses a hierarchical μGraph representation (kernel/thread-block/thread levels), abstract-expression pruning, and probabilistic equivalence verification over finite fields to automatically discover fused custom kernels (e.g., fused RMSNorm+MatMul, GQA, LoRA, GatedMLP), reporting up to 3.3x speedups on A100/H100 GPUs. It is a compiler/optimizer, not a neural model.

title: Single-seed generation of Brownian paths and integrals for adaptive and high order SDE solvers
summary: The paper extends the Virtual Brownian Tree (VBT) so that a single PRNG seed deterministically generates Brownian motion together with space-time and space-time-time Lévy areas at arbitrary (non-dyadic) query times, enabling adaptive high-order SDE solvers (e.g. for CIR and underdamped Langevin MCMC) with O(1) memory and provably correct joint distributions for sufficiently spaced queries.

title: Chameleon: Mixed-Modal Early-Fusion Foundation Models
summary: A family of early-fusion, token-based mixed-modal transformers that treat images and text as discrete tokens in one autoregressive model, with stability techniques (QK-Norm, norm reordering, z-loss, dropout) enabling training at 7B/34B scale on ~10T interleaved tokens (paraphrase of Sections 1-2).

title: When LLMs step into the 3D World: A Survey and Meta-Analysis of 3D Tasks via Multi-modal Large Language Models
summary: A survey (not a model paper) that taxonomizes how LLMs ingest 3D data (point clouds, multi-view images, scene graphs, NeRFs), categorizes 3D vision-language tasks (captioning, grounding, QA, embodied agents, generation), and reviews alignment-module designs (linear/MLP, transformer, Q-Former) and fine-tuning strategies (LoRA, adaptive, layer freezing, prompt tuning).

title: Dynamic data sampler for cross-language transfer learning in large language models
summary: ChatFlow: continued training of LLaMA2-7B on a mix of Chinese, English, parallel, and instruction data, with a curriculum-style dynamic data sampler that linearly shifts sampling weights from English/unsupervised data toward Chinese/instruction data over Tgrow=5M samples, enabling cost-effective cross-language transfer (paper Section 2).

title: OpenRLHF: An Easy-to-use, Scalable and High-performance RLHF Framework
summary: A systems paper presenting OpenRLHF, an open-source RLHF/RLVR training framework built on Ray, vLLM, DeepSpeed, and HuggingFace Transformers, featuring Ray-based orchestration of rollout and training engines, 3D parallelism (tensor/data/sequence via AutoTP and ring attention), vLLM-accelerated CoT inference, and asynchronous engine communication, with reported 1.22x-1.68x speedups over verl. It is a training framework, not a model architecture.

title: Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy
summary: Octo is an open-source transformer-based generalist robot manipulation policy pretrained on 800k Open X-Embodiment trajectories, supporting language/goal-image task conditioning, flexible observation and action spaces, and efficient finetuning to new robots (paper facts).

title: Diffusion for World Modeling: Visual Details Matter in Atari
summary: DIAMOND: an RL agent trained inside a diffusion-based (EDM) world model that predicts next Atari frames directly in image space conditioned on past frames/actions, achieving 1.46 mean human-normalized score on Atari 100k, plus a CS:GO neural game engine demo.

title: PipeFusion: Patch-level Pipeline Parallelism for Diffusion Transformers Inference
summary: The paper proposes PipeFusion, an inference-time parallelization method for diffusion transformers (DiTs) that partitions both the input latent sequence into patches and the DiT layers across GPUs, using a patch-level pipeline that reuses stale activations from the previous diffusion timestep to overlap communication with computation, reducing communication and memory costs versus tensor/sequence parallelism and DistriFusion.

title: HippoRAG: Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models
summary: A retrieval framework that uses an LLM to build an open knowledge graph over a corpus (offline indexing), then runs Personalized PageRank seeded by query entities (online retrieval) to achieve single-step multi-hop retrieval, outperforming standard and iterative RAG baselines on multi-hop QA.

title: The Road Less Scheduled
summary: The paper proposes Schedule-Free optimization (Schedule-Free SGD and Schedule-Free AdamW), which replaces learning-rate schedules with an interpolate-then-average scheme over three iterate sequences (z, y, x), removing the need to know the stopping time T while matching or beating tuned cosine schedules (paper Sections 1-2, 4).

title: Bridging The Gap between Low-rank and Orthogonal Adaptation via Householder Reflection Adaptation
summary: The paper proposes Householder Reflection Adaptation (HRA), a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that multiplies each frozen pre-trained weight matrix W by a chain of r learnable Householder reflections H(r) = Π(I − 2 u_i u_i^T). This is simultaneously an orthogonal adaptation (each reflection is orthogonal) and an adaptive low-rank adaptation (W H(r) = W + W U_r Γ_r U_r^T). An orthogonality regularizer λ Σ ||I − U^T U||² trades off capacity

title: PromptWizard: Task-Aware Prompt Optimization Framework
summary: PromptWizard (per the paper) is a discrete, gradient-free prompt optimization framework for black-box LLMs that iteratively mutates, scores, critiques, and synthesizes prompt instructions and few-shot examples, adding chain-of-thought reasoning, task intent, and expert personas; it is an orchestration/agent pipeline, not a trainable neural architecture.

title: EasyAnimate: A High-Performance Long Video Generation Method based on Transformer Architecture
summary: A text-to-video diffusion transformer framework (EasyAnimate) combining Hybrid Windows Attention (multidirectional sliding window attention interleaved with 3D full attention), a Qwen2-VL MLLM text encoder, a 3D causal VAE, rectified-flow DiT training with a token-length batching strategy, and post-training via reward backpropagation (HPSv2.1 + MPS) with LoRA.

title: Adaptive In-conversation Team Building for Language Model Agents
summary: Proposes Captain Agent, an LLM-based orchestrator that adaptively builds and manages agent teams per subtask via RAG-based agent/tool retrieval, nested group conversations, and LLM reflection, improving accuracy over static multi-agent baselines across six task scenarios.

title: TotalSegmentator MRI: Robust Sequence-independent Segmentation of Multiple Anatomic Structures in MRI
summary: An open-source nnU-Net (U-Net-based) model trained on mixed MRI+CT data to segment 80 anatomic structures in MRI of any sequence, achieving Dice 0.839 on an internal MRI test set and outperforming MRSegmentator and an AMOS-trained nnU-Net (paper facts from Abstract/Results).

title: Unique3D: High-Quality and Efficient 3D Mesh Generation from a Single Image
summary: A single-image-to-3D framework combining a multi-view diffusion model, a normal-map diffusion model, multi-level upscaling, and the ISOMER mesh reconstruction algorithm to produce high-fidelity textured meshes in ~30 seconds.

title: Seed-TTS: A Family of High-Quality Versatile Speech Generation Models
summary: A family of large-scale autoregressive transformer TTS models (plus a fully diffusion-based variant, Seed-TTS-DiT) achieving human-level zero-shot speech in-context learning, with self-distillation for timbre factorization and RL-based post-training (per paper Sections 1-4).

title: V-Express: Conditional Dropout for Progressive Training of Portrait Video Generation
summary: A portrait video generation method that balances control signals of different strengths (reference image, V-Kps pose images, audio) via progressive three-stage training and conditional dropout, enabling audio-driven lip sync on an SDv1.5-based latent diffusion backbone (paraphrase of Sections 1-2).

title: RoboCasa: Large-Scale Simulation of Everyday Tasks for Generalist Robots
summary: A large-scale MuJoCo/RoboSuite-based kitchen simulation framework with 120 scenes, 2,500+ AI-generated 3D objects, 100 tasks (25 atomic, 75 LLM-guided composite), and 100K+ trajectories via MimicGen, showing scaling trends for behavioral-cloning imitation learning and sim-to-real co-training gains.

title: Scalable MatMul-free Language Modeling
summary: The paper proposes a MatMul-free language model that replaces dense layers with ternary-weight BitLinear layers (ternary accumulation) and replaces self-attention with a MatMul-free Linear Gated Recurrent Unit (MLGRU) token mixer plus a BitLinear GLU channel mixer, showing competitive performance up to 2.7B parameters with large memory/energy savings (Sections 1-2, 6).

title: Bench2Drive: Towards Multi-Ability Benchmarking of Closed-Loop End-To-End Autonomous Driving
summary: The paper introduces Bench2Drive, a closed-loop CARLA v2 benchmark for end-to-end autonomous driving with a 2-million-frame official expert dataset (13,638 clips, 44 interactive scenarios, 23 weathers, 12 towns) and a 220-short-route multi-ability evaluation protocol measuring Driving Score, Success Rate, Efficiency, and Comfortness, plus reimplemented baselines (AD-MLP, UniAD, VAD, TCP, ThinkTwice, DriveAdapter).

title: Mixture-of-Agents Enhances Large Language Model Capabilities
summary: The paper proposes Mixture-of-Agents (MoA), a training-free prompting orchestration in which multiple LLM 'proposer' agents in each layer generate responses, which are concatenated and passed via an 'Aggregate-and-Synthesize' prompt to the next layer's agents, with a final aggregator LLM producing the output. It reports state-of-the-art AlpacaEval 2.0 LC win rates (65.1%) using only open-source LLMs and identifies 'collaborativeness' of LLMs.

title: Autoregressive Model Beats Diffusion: Llama for Scalable Image Generation
summary: LlamaGen applies vanilla Llama-style next-token prediction to image generation using a VQGAN-style image tokenizer, scaling class-conditional models from 111M to 3.1B parameters (2.18 FID on ImageNet 256x256) and a 775M text-conditional model trained in two stages on LAION-COCO and high-aesthetics images.

title: TextGrad: Automatic "Differentiation" via Text
summary: TextGrad (per the paper) is a framework that treats compound AI systems as computation graphs over text variables and backpropagates natural-language feedback ('textual gradients') produced by LLMs, using a Textual Gradient Descent (TGD) optimizer, applied to code optimization, question answering, prompt optimization, molecule design, and radiotherapy planning.

title: Hallo: Hierarchical Audio-Driven Visual Synthesis for Portrait Image Animation
summary: An end-to-end latent diffusion approach for animating a portrait image from speech audio, replacing intermediate facial representations with a hierarchical audio-visual cross-attention module that separately aligns audio with lip, expression, and pose regions, fused via zero-convolution adaptive weighting (paper facts, Sections 1, 3.2).

title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: A 7B-parameter open-source vision-language-action model built on a Prismatic VLM (fused SigLIP+DINOv2 vision encoder, MLP projector, Llama 2 7B backbone), fine-tuned on 970k Open X-Embodiment robot episodes by discretizing actions into 256 tokens per dimension and training with next-token prediction on action tokens only; also demonstrates LoRA fine-tuning and 4-bit quantized inference.

title: MeshAnything: Artist-Created Mesh Generation with Autoregressive Transformers
summary: Reframes mesh extraction as shape-conditioned generation: a VQ-VAE learns a mesh token vocabulary and a decoder-only autoregressive transformer, conditioned on point-cloud shape features, generates Artist-Created Meshes with far fewer faces than reconstruction-based extraction, plus a noise-resistant shape-conditioned VQ-VAE decoder.

title: DB-GPT-Hub: Towards Open Benchmarking Text-to-SQL Empowered by Large Language Models
summary: An open benchmark suite (per Section 3) that standardizes fine-tuning of medium-to-large open LLMs (GLM, Qwen, Baichuan, Llama families) for text-to-SQL using LoRA/QLoRA PEFT, TRP-formatted prompts, and EX/EM evaluation on Spider and BIRD, comparing tuning vs prompting.

title: Autoregressive Image Generation without Vector Quantization
summary: The paper (per 'Extracted text block 13' abstract) proposes Diffusion Loss: an autoregressive/masked-autoregressive (MAR) image generator that models each token's per-token probability with a small denoising diffusion MLP on continuous-valued tokens, removing the need for vector-quantized tokenizers, and unifies AR and masked generative models under random-order, bidirectional-attention autoregression.

title: DeepSeek-Coder-V2: Breaking the Barrier of Closed-Source Models in Code Intelligence
summary: An open-source Mixture-of-Experts code language model (16B/236B total, 2.4B/21B active) built on the DeepSeek-V2 (DeepSeek2) MoE architecture, further pre-trained on 6T tokens (60% code, 10% math, 30% natural language), extending language support to 338 programming languages and context to 128K via YaRN, with SFT and GRPO-based RL alignment.

title: ChatGLM: A Family of Large Language Models from GLM-130B to GLM-4 All Tools
summary: A technical report describing the ChatGLM/GLM-4 model family: GLM-4 architecture choices (no bias except QKV, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, 2D RoPE, GQA), ~10-trillion-token pre-training, multi-stage SFT/RLHF alignment, and an All Tools agent variant. Paper facts only; no code-level training recipe sufficient for reproduction.

title: ExVideo: Extending Video Diffusion Models via Parameter-Efficient Post-Tuning
summary: A post-tuning method (ExVideo) that extends video diffusion models (applied to Stable Video Diffusion) to generate longer videos by replacing static positional embeddings with extended trainable cyclic embeddings, fine-tuning temporal attention, and adding an identity-initialized 3D convolution adapter, trained with frozen non-temporal parameters.

title: Instruction Pre-Training: Language Models are Supervised Multitask Learners
summary: Proposes Instruction Pre-Training: augment raw pre-training corpora with instruction-response pairs synthesized by a fine-tuned open-source 7B model, then pre-train LMs on the augmented corpora, improving data efficiency and downstream generalization (paraphrase of Sections 1-2).

title: Cambrian-1: A Fully Open, Vision-Centric Exploration of Multimodal LLMs
summary: A vision-centric study of multimodal LLMs: systematic evaluation of 20+ vision encoders via visual instruction tuning, a new spatially-aware connector (SVA), curated instruction data (Cambrian-10M/7M), and a family of state-of-the-art open MLLMs plus the CV-Bench benchmark.

title: Unambiguous Recognition Should Not Rely Solely on Natural Language Training
summary: MixTeX is a LaTeX OCR system that pretrains an image-to-LaTeX model entirely on synthetic data (randomly paired Wikipedia text and LaTeX formulas, compiled to page images) and then fine-tunes on only 400 real samples, outperforming Nougat and Hunyuan on a 977-sample bilingual benchmark (paper facts).

title: MimicMotion: High-Quality Human Motion Video Generation with Confidence-aware Pose Guidance
summary: A pose-guided human video generation framework built on Stable Video Diffusion that adds confidence-aware pose guidance (confidence-weighted pose maps), hand-region loss amplification, and a training-free progressive latent fusion for long, temporally smooth videos.

title: ROS-LLM: A ROS framework for embodied AI with task feedback and structured reasoning
summary: A ROS-integrated framework (per the paper) where an LLM agent converts natural-language task descriptions, environment observations, and human feedback into executable robot behaviors (action sequences, behavior trees, state machines), with imitation learning (DMP) to extend an atomic action library. It is a systems/orchestration framework, not a single trainable neural architecture.

title: Scaling Synthetic Data Creation with 1,000,000,000 Personas
summary: The paper proposes persona-driven data synthesis: a curated collection of 1 billion personas (Persona Hub) built from web text via Text-to-Persona and Persona-to-Persona expansion, used to prompt LLMs to create diverse synthetic data (math problems, instructions, texts, NPCs, tools) at scale. It is a data-creation methodology, not a neural architecture.

title: Mooncake: A KVCache-centric Disaggregated Architecture for LLM Serving
summary: A distributed LLM serving system that disaggregates prefill and decoding clusters and treats KVCache as the central scheduling resource, using a distributed CPU/DRAM/SSD KVCache pool, chunked pipeline parallelism for prefill, cache-aware scheduling, and prediction-based early rejection to maximize throughput under latency SLOs.

title: ColPali: Efficient Document Retrieval with Vision Language Models
summary: The paper introduces ViDoRe, a benchmark for page-level document retrieval with visually rich documents, and ColPali, a PaliGemma-3B-based VLM fine-tuned to emit ColBERT-style multi-vector embeddings from page images, matched to queries via late interaction (per-paper sections 3-4).

title: Agentless: Demystifying LLM-based Software Engineering Agents
summary: Agentless is a three-phase, non-agentic pipeline (hierarchical localization, repair via Search/Replace diffs, patch validation with reproduction tests) that resolves SWE-bench Lite issues at 32.00% with $0.70 average cost using GPT-4o, and introduces the filtered SWE-bench Lite-S benchmark.

title: LivePortrait: Efficient Portrait Animation with Stitching and Retargeting Control
summary: A video-driven portrait animation framework built on implicit-keypoint warping (face vid2vid style), enhanced with scaled training data, a unified motion extractor, scalable motion transformation, landmark-guided keypoint optimization, and lightweight MLP-based stitching and eyes/lip retargeting modules for controllable, efficient animation.

title: BM25S: Orders of magnitude faster lexical search via eager sparse scoring
summary: A NumPy/SciPy-only BM25 implementation that eagerly precomputes all token-document scores at index time into sparse matrices, enabling fast query-time slicing/summation, plus score shifting for non-sparse BM25 variants and O(n) top-k selection (paper facts).

title: FunAudioLLM: Voice Understanding and Generation Foundation Models for Natural Interaction Between Humans and LLMs
summary: A model family pairing SenseVoice (multilingual ASR plus emotion and audio-event understanding, in non-autoregressive encoder-only Small and encoder-decoder Large variants) with CosyVoice (autoregressive speech-token LM plus flow-matching and HiFTNet vocoder synthesis), enabled by a supervised semantic speech tokenizer (S3), for voice-driven LLM interaction.

title: MambaVision: A Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Vision Backbone
summary: A hierarchical vision backbone combining redesigned Mamba (SSM) mixer blocks with self-attention blocks placed in the final stages, achieving a new accuracy-throughput Pareto front on ImageNet-1K (paraphrase of Sections 1, 3, 5).

title: EchoMimic: Lifelike Audio-Driven Portrait Animations through Editable Landmark Conditions
summary: EchoMimic is a Stable Diffusion-based portrait animation framework trained jointly on audio and facial landmark conditions, enabling talking-head video generation driven by audio alone, landmarks alone, or both, with a two-stage training strategy, random landmark selection, audio augmentation, and a timestep-aware spatial loss.

title: Qwen2 Technical Report
summary: The Qwen2 report (Sections 1-2) introduces a family of dense (0.5B-72B) and MoE (57B-A14B) decoder-only Transformer LLMs using GQA, SwiGLU, RoPE, QKV bias, RMSNorm pre-norm, plus long-context (DCA+YARN) and SFT/DPO post-training, evaluated across multilingual, coding, math, and reasoning benchmarks.

title: Qwen2-Audio Technical Report
summary: Qwen2-Audio is an 8.2B-parameter large audio-language model combining a Whisper-large-v3-initialized audio encoder with the Qwen-7B LLM, trained in three stages (multi-task pre-training with natural language prompts, SFT, DPO) to support voice chat and audio analysis modes without system prompts.

title: Semantic Operators: A Declarative Model for Rich, AI-based Data Processing
summary: The paper proposes semantic operators, a declarative relational-style formalism for LLM-based data transformations (filter, join, agg, top-k, group-by, map), each defined by a gold algorithm, plus proxy-based optimized execution plans with statistical accuracy guarantees, implemented in the LOTUS system.

title: Data-Juicer Sandbox: A Comprehensive Suite for Multimodal Data-Model Co-development
summary: An open-source sandbox suite (Data-Juicer Sandbox) that couples multimodal data processing with model training/evaluation via a 'Probe-Analyze-Refine' workflow: small-scale single-operator and multi-operator data pools are probed with reference models, analyzed for OP-metric correlations, and refined into data recipes that transfer to larger-scale multimodal training (image-to-text, text-to-video, image-text pre-training, image captioning).

title: NeedleBench: Can LLMs Do Retrieval and Reasoning in 1 Million Context Window?
summary: The paper introduces NeedleBench, a synthetic bilingual benchmark for evaluating LLM long-context retrieval and reasoning at adaptive lengths (4k to 1M tokens), spanning information-sparse tasks (S-RT, M-RT, M-RS) and the information-dense Ancestral Trace Challenge (ATC), and identifies the 'under-thinking' failure mode. It is an evaluation framework, not a proposed model architecture.

title: LMMs-Eval: Reality Check on the Evaluation of Large Multimodal Models
summary: The paper contributes an evaluation framework, not a model: (1) LMMs-Eval, a unified standardized suite for evaluating large multimodal models across 50+ tasks and 10+ models; (2) LMMs-Eval-Lite, a pruned coreset-based subset (k-Center greedy over CLIP+BGE embeddings) that preserves score correlation at lower cost; (3) LiveBench, a dynamically updated benchmark built from news/forum screenshots with LLM-generated QA to avoid contamination. It is

title: Stable Audio Open
summary: An open-weights latent diffusion text-to-audio model (Stable Audio Open) trained on Creative Commons data, generating variable-length stereo audio at 44.1kHz via a waveform autoencoder, T5 text conditioning, and a diffusion transformer (DiT).

title: Stretching Each Dollar: Diffusion Training from Scratch on a Micro-Budget
summary: The paper proposes MicroDiT, a latent diffusion transformer for text-to-image generation trained on a micro-budget, using a deferred patch-masking strategy (a lightweight patch-mixer processes all patches before 75% masking), mixture-of-experts layers with expert-choice routing, and layer-wise scaling, achieving 12.66 FID-30K on COCO for $1,890 (per paper).

title: CatVTON: Concatenation Is All You Need for Virtual Try-On with Diffusion Models
summary: A lightweight diffusion-based virtual try-on model that concatenates person and garment images spatially as UNet input, removing image/text encoders, ReferenceNet, and cross-attention; only self-attention layers are fine-tuned (49.57M trainable params of 899.06M total), and inference needs no pose/parsing/captioning preprocessing.

title: OpenHands: An Open Platform for AI Software Developers as Generalist Agents
summary: The paper presents OpenHands (f.k.a. OpenDevin), an open platform for building AI software-developer agents: an event-stream architecture, a Docker-sandboxed runtime (bash, IPython, browser), an AgentSkills tool library, multi-agent delegation, an agent hub, and evaluation across 15 benchmarks. It is a systems/platform paper, not a model-training paper.

title: Very Large-Scale Multi-Agent Simulation in AgentScope
summary: The paper extends the AgentScope multi-agent platform with an actor-based distributed mechanism (agent-level parallel execution and automatic workflow conversion via to_dist), flexible agent-environment interactions, heterogeneous agent configuration with automatic background generation, and a web-based Agent-Manager, demonstrated via large-scale 'guess 2/3 of the average' simulations with up to 1 million LLM agents (paper Sections 3-4).

title: MindSearch: Mimicking Human Minds Elicits Deep AI Searcher
summary: MindSearch is an LLM-based multi-agent framework (WebPlanner + WebSearcher) that models complex question answering as iterative DAG construction via code generation, with hierarchical web retrieval per sub-question, improving depth/breadth of QA responses over ReAct-style baselines (Sections 1-3).

title: OmniParser for Pure Vision Based GUI Agent
summary: OmniParser is a pure-vision UI screen parsing pipeline combining a finetuned interactable-region detector (YOLOv8), a finetuned BLIP-2 icon captioner, and an OCR module, whose structured output (bounding boxes, IDs, local semantics) improves GPT-4V action grounding on ScreenSpot, Mind2Web, and AITW (paper facts).

title: CodexGraph: Bridging Large Language Models and Code Repositories via Code Graph Databases
summary: A system (not a trained model) that indexes Python code repositories into a Neo4j graph database via static analysis, and uses a two-agent LLM pipeline (primary agent writes natural-language queries; translation agent converts them to Cypher) in an iterative loop for structure-aware code retrieval across repository-level coding tasks.

title: Transformer Explainer: Interactive Learning of Text-Generative Models
summary: An interactive web-based visualization tool (Transformer Explainer) that teaches non-experts how decoder-only Transformers (GPT-2) generate text, via token-centric Sankey-style data-flow visualization, step-by-step expanded views of attention/embedding/probability computations, live in-browser inference with adjustable sampling hyperparameters (temperature, top-k, top-p), and a guided-learning feature; validated with a 90-participant user study.

title: A Survey of Text-to-SQL in the Era of LLMs: Where are we, and where are we going?
summary: A survey (not a model paper) reviewing the full Text-to-SQL lifecycle in the LLM era: model techniques (pre-processing, translation, post-processing), benchmarks and data synthesis, evaluation metrics, and a two-level error taxonomy, plus practical roadmaps for LLM-based Text-to-SQL.

title: ControlNeXt: Powerful and Efficient Control for Image and Video Generation
summary: ControlNeXt replaces heavy ControlNet-style auxiliary branches with a lightweight convolution module that injects control signals into a partially fine-tuned diffusion backbone, plus Cross Normalization (normalizing control features with the main branch's statistics) for faster, more stable convergence.

title: CogVideoX: Text-to-Video Diffusion Models with An Expert Transformer
summary: A large-scale text-to-video diffusion transformer combining a 3D causal VAE for spatiotemporal compression, an expert transformer with expert adaptive LayerNorm and 3D full attention for text-video fusion, plus progressive training, frame packing, and a video captioning/filtering pipeline (Sections 1-3).

title: Mutual Reasoning Makes Smaller LLMs Stronger Problem-Solvers
summary: rStar is an inference-time self-play method: a target small language model (SLM) generates candidate reasoning trajectories via MCTS with five human-like reasoning actions, and a second SLM discriminator verifies trajectories via mutual consistency (completing partially hinted trajectories), boosting math/commonsense reasoning accuracy without fine-tuning.

title: TacSL: A Library for Visuotactile Sensor Simulation and Learning
summary: TacSL is a GPU-accelerated visuotactile sensor simulation library (tactile RGB images and normal/shear force fields) integrated with Isaac Simulator/PhysX, plus a policy-learning toolkit (BC, DAgger, asymmetric actor-critic, and a novel AACD algorithm) enabling zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of tactile manipulation policies. This is a robotics simulation/RL paper, not a conversational model paper.

title: LongWriter: Unleashing 10,000+ Word Generation from Long Context LLMs
summary: The paper shows that LLM output length is bounded by maximum output lengths in SFT data, introduces AgentWrite (a plan-then-write agent pipeline) to build LongWriter-6k, a 6k-example long-output SFT dataset, and demonstrates that SFT (plus DPO) on this data extends model generation to 10,000+ words, evaluated with the LongBench-Write benchmark.

title: Automated Design of Agentic Systems
summary: The paper proposes ADAS, a research area for automatically designing agentic systems, and introduces Meta Agent Search: a meta agent (GPT-4) iteratively programs new agents in Python code, evaluates them on validation data, and maintains an archive of discoveries that conditions future designs. Discovered agents outperform hand-designed baselines on ARC, DROP, MGSM, MMLU, and GPQA and transfer across domains and foundation models.

title: Show-o: One Single Transformer to Unify Multimodal Understanding and Generation
summary: Show-o unifies multimodal understanding and generation in one transformer by combining autoregressive modeling for text tokens with MaskGIT-style discrete diffusion (mask token prediction) for image tokens, using an omni-attention mechanism that mixes causal and full attention per modality (Sections 1, 3.2).

title: Real-Time Video Generation with Pyramid Attention Broadcast
summary: PAB is a training-free inference acceleration method for DiT-based video diffusion models: it broadcasts spatial, temporal, and cross-attention outputs (and some MLP outputs) across consecutive diffusion steps within the stable middle segment of the diffusion process, using per-attention-type broadcast ranges, plus a broadcast sequence parallelism scheme that removes communication when temporal attention is broadcast.

title: Eagle: Exploring The Design Space for Multimodal LLMs with Mixture of Encoders
summary: A systematic design-space study of mixture-of-vision-encoder MLLMs (per Section 2), finding that channel concatenation of visual tokens from complementary encoders, unlocking encoders during training, and a Pre-Alignment stage yield the Eagle family of MLLMs with strong benchmark results (Sections 2-3).

title: CogVLM2: Visual Language Models for Image and Video Understanding
summary: The CogVLM2 family (CogVLM2, CogVLM2-Video, GLM-4V) are visual language models combining an EVA-CLIP ViT encoder, a 2x2 convolution + SwiGLU adapter, and an LLM backbone (LLaMA3-8B or GLM-4-9B), with an optional visual-expert module for deep vision-language fusion; CogVLM2-Video adds multi-frame timestamped input and automated temporal-grounding data generation.

title: Mini-Omni: Language Models Can Hear, Talk While Thinking in Streaming
summary: Mini-Omni is an open-source end-to-end speech-to-speech conversational model (Qwen2-0.5B base) that generates text and audio tokens in parallel via text-instructed delayed parallel decoding over SNAC multi-codebook tokens, plus a three-stage 'Any Model Can Talk' adaptation recipe and the VoiceAssistant-400K dataset.

title: rerankers: A Lightweight Python Library to Unify Ranking Methods
summary: The paper introduces rerankers, a lightweight Python library providing a unified interface (Reranker class, RankedResults objects) over diverse re-ranking methods (cross-encoders, T5-based, ColBERT-based, listwise LLM rerankers, API-only models), emphasizing minimal dependencies, extensibility, and performance parity with original implementations. It is a systems/library paper, not a new model architecture paper.

title: FLUX that Plays Music
summary: FluxMusic extends the FLUX rectified-flow Transformer to text-to-music generation: a MMDiT-style model with double-stream text/music blocks followed by single-stream music blocks, operating in a latent VAE mel-spectrogram space, conditioned by frozen CLAP-L (coarse) and T5-XXL (fine) text encoders (paraphrased from Sections 1 and 3.2).

title: General OCR Theory: Towards OCR-2.0 via a Unified End-to-end Model
summary: Proposes GOT, a 580M-parameter unified end-to-end OCR-2.0 model combining a high-compression VitDet-based vision encoder (1024x1024 input to 256 image tokens) with a Qwen-0.5B long-context decoder, trained in three stages to handle plain, formatted, fine-grained, dynamic-resolution, and multi-page OCR of diverse optical 'characters' (paper facts, Section 1/3).

title: ViewCrafter: Taming Video Diffusion Models for High-fidelity Novel View Synthesis
summary: A point-conditioned video diffusion model that synthesizes high-fidelity, pose-accurate novel views from single or sparse images, using point cloud renders from a dense stereo model as explicit camera control, plus iterative view synthesis with next-best-view trajectory planning and downstream 3D-GS optimization.

title: DepthCrafter: Generating Consistent Long Depth Sequences for Open-world Videos
summary: DepthCrafter adapts a pre-trained image-to-video diffusion model (SVD) into a video-to-depth diffusion model, trained in three stages on realistic and synthetic paired video-depth data, to generate temporally consistent depth sequences up to 110 frames with segment-wise inference and latent interpolation stitching for longer videos.

title: MemoRAG: Moving towards Next-Gen RAG Via Memory-Inspired Knowledge Discovery
summary: MemoRAG is a dual-system RAG framework: a light long-range memory model compresses a long context into a compact KV memory (memory tokens with separate Q/K/V projections), generates draft answer clues for a query, which guide retrieval of evidence used by a larger generator LLM; the memory module is trained via pre-training, SFT, and RLGF (reinforcement learning with generation feedback).

title: LLaMA-Omni: Seamless Speech Interaction with Large Language Models
summary: Proposes LLaMA-Omni, an end-to-end speech interaction model combining a frozen Whisper speech encoder, a trainable speech adaptor, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and a non-autoregressive streaming CTC speech decoder, trained on the InstructS2S-200K dataset to generate text and speech responses simultaneously with latency as low as 236ms.

title: gsplat: An Open-Source Library for Gaussian Splatting
summary: An open-source PyTorch/CUDA library for training and rendering 3D Gaussian Splatting models, with modular densification strategies (ADC, Absgrad, MCMC), differentiable pose optimization, depth rendering, N-D rasterization, and anti-aliasing, achieving equal rendering quality to the original 3DGS with less memory and training time (Sections 1-4).

title: Gated Slot Attention for Efficient Linear-Time Sequence Modeling
summary: The paper proposes Gated Slot Attention (GSA), a linear-time sequence model that enhances ABC (Attention with Bounded-memory-Control) with a GLA-style data-dependent gating mechanism. GSA is expressible as two gated linear attention passes linked by a softmax, giving context-aware memory reading, adaptive forgetting, a small recurrent state (64 slots), hardware-efficient chunkwise training, and strong in-context recall and Transformer-to-RNN (T2R

title: MarS: a Financial Market Simulation Engine Powered by Generative Foundation Model
summary: The paper proposes LMM, an order-level generative foundation model (a causal transformer Order Model over order+LOB tokens, a VQGAN-based Order-Batch Model over 'order images', and a cross-attention Ensemble Model), embedded in the MarS simulation engine with a simulated clearing house, enabling realistic, controllable, interactive financial market simulation for forecasting, detection, what-if analysis, and RL agent training.

title: MAISI: Medical AI for Synthetic Imaging
summary: MAISI is a three-stage framework for high-resolution 3D CT volume synthesis: a 3D VAE-GAN volume compression network, a latent diffusion model conditioned on body region and voxel spacing, and a ControlNet for task-specific conditioning (e.g., 127-structure segmentation masks, tumor inpainting), using tensor splitting parallelism to overcome GPU memory limits (paper Secs. 1, 3).

title: KAG: Boosting LLMs in Professional Domains via Knowledge Augmented Generation
summary: KAG is a knowledge-service framework combining knowledge graphs and vector retrieval via LLM-friendly knowledge representation (LLMFriSPG), mutual indexing between graphs and text chunks, a logical-form-guided hybrid reasoning solver, semantic knowledge alignment, and fine-tuned LLMs (NLU/NLI/NLG enhancements, K-LoRA, AKGF, OneGen), improving multi-hop QA over RAG baselines.

title: Emu3: Next-Token Prediction is All You Need
summary: Emu3 trains a single decoder-only transformer from scratch with next-token prediction on mixed text, image, and video token sequences, using a discrete vision tokenizer (SBER-MoVQGAN-based), achieving strong image/video generation and vision-language understanding without diffusion or CLIP-based composition (per paper Sections 1-3).

title: Moshi: a speech-text foundation model for real-time dialogue
summary: Moshi is a full-duplex speech-text foundation model: a 7B text LLM (Helium) extended with a Depth Transformer (RQ-Transformer) that hierarchically generates Mimi codec audio tokens for two parallel speaker streams, with time-aligned text tokens as a prefix (Inner Monologue), enabling real-time spoken dialogue with ~160ms theoretical latency.

title: Depth Pro: Sharp Monocular Metric Depth in Less Than a Second
summary: A foundation model for zero-shot metric monocular depth estimation that applies a shared plain ViT patch encoder at multiple scales, fuses features via a DPT-style decoder, adds a focal length estimation head, and uses a two-stage real+synthetic training curriculum with derivative losses for sharp boundaries (paraphrase of Sections 1, 3).

title: Differential Transformer
summary: Proposes Diff Transformer, a decoder-only LLM architecture whose attention computes the difference of two softmax attention maps (with a learnable scalar lambda) to cancel attention noise, improving retrieval, long-context use, in-context learning robustness, and reducing activation outliers (Sections 1-2).

title: LightRAG: Simple and Fast Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: LightRAG is a retrieval-augmented generation framework that builds a knowledge graph from documents via LLM-based entity/relation extraction, indexes entities and relations as key-value entries, retrieves via a dual-level (low-level entity / high-level theme) keyword-plus-vector strategy over the graph, and incrementally updates the graph without full reindexing (Sections 3.1-3.3).

title: Pyramidal Flow Matching for Efficient Video Generative Modeling
summary: Proposes pyramidal flow matching: a single unified Diffusion Transformer trained with a piecewise flow-matching objective over spatial pyramid stages (only the last stage at full resolution) plus a temporal pyramid of compressed history conditions for autoregressive video generation, enabling efficient 5-10s 768p 24fps video synthesis (paper claim).

title: F5-TTS: A Fairytaler that Fakes Fluent and Faithful Speech with Flow Matching
summary: A fully non-autoregressive zero-shot TTS system using flow matching with a Diffusion Transformer, ConvNeXt V2 text refinement, and an inference-time Sway Sampling strategy for flow steps (paraphrase of Sections 1-3).

title: Pixtral 12B
summary: A 12B-parameter multimodal language model combining a 400M vision encoder (Pixtral-ViT) supporting native resolution/aspect-ratio images via RoPE-2D and sequence packing, with a Mistral Nemo-based decoder; also introduces the MM-MT-Bench evaluation benchmark and standardized prompting/parsing protocols.

title: MLE-bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Machine Learning Engineering
summary: The paper introduces MLE-bench, a benchmark of 75 curated Kaggle competitions with local grading and human leaderboard baselines, used to evaluate autonomous ML engineering agents; best setup (o1-preview with AIDE) achieves a medal in 16.9% of competitions. It is a benchmark/evaluation paper, not a model architecture paper.

title: Hallo2: Long-Duration and High-Resolution Audio-Driven Portrait Image Animation
summary: Extends the Hallo latent-diffusion portrait animation system to hour-long, 4K videos via patch-drop plus Gaussian-noise augmentation of motion frames, a VQGAN codebook super-resolution module with temporal alignment, and CLIP-text prompt control through adaptive layer normalization (paraphrase of Sections 1 and 4).

title: RDT-1B: a Diffusion Foundation Model for Bimanual Manipulation
summary: RDT is a 1.2B-parameter diffusion transformer policy for language-conditioned bimanual manipulation, pre-trained on 46 multi-robot datasets (1M+ trajectories) using a Physically Interpretable Unified Action Space (128-dim), then fine-tuned on a 6K+ episode bimanual ALOHA dataset, achieving zero-shot generalization, instruction following, few-shot learning, and dexterous control.

title: KV Prediction for Improved Time to First Token
summary: The paper proposes KV Prediction: a small auxiliary transformer processes the prompt, and learned per-layer linear projections map the auxiliary model's KV cache to an approximation of a larger frozen base model's KV cache, so the first token is generated by a single-token pass of the base model, reducing time-to-first-token (TTFT) with pareto-optimal accuracy-efficiency trade-offs (Sections 1, 4).

title: OpenR: An Open Source Framework for Advanced Reasoning with Large Language Models
summary: OpenR is an open-source framework unifying process-supervision data generation (MATH-APS via OmegaPRM), supervised PRM training (Math-psa), RL policy learning (PPO/GRPO), and PRM-guided test-time decoding (best-of-N, beam search) to improve LLM math reasoning, evaluated on MATH500.

title: MuseTalk: Real-Time High Quality Lip Synchronization with Latent Space Inpainting
summary: A GAN-based one-step video-dubbing framework that inpaints the lower face in VAE latent space, using a two-stage training strategy (Facial Abstract Pretraining then Lip-Sync Adversarial Finetuning) with Informative Frame Sampling and Dynamic Margin Sampling to balance lip-sync accuracy, identity preservation, and dental detail at 30 FPS on a V100 (per paper, Section 1/5).

title: Deep Compression Autoencoder for Efficient High-Resolution Diffusion Models
summary: DC-AE is a family of image autoencoders achieving spatial compression ratios up to 128x by (1) Residual Autoencoding (non-parametric space-to-channel shortcuts in downsample/upsample blocks) and (2) Decoupled High-Resolution Adaptation (three-phase training), enabling large diffusion-model speedups with no FID loss.

title: Liger Kernel: Efficient Triton Kernels for LLM Training
summary: A library of fused Triton GPU kernels (RMSNorm, LayerNorm, RoPE, SwiGLU, GeGLU, CrossEntropy, FusedLinearCrossEntropy) that speed up LLM training (~20% throughput gain, ~60% GPU memory reduction reported) via kernel fusion and input chunking, with drop-in patching APIs and rigorous correctness/performance/convergence testing.

title: Mini-Omni2: Towards Open-source GPT-4o with Vision, Speech and Duplex Capabilities
summary: Mini-Omni2 unifies vision, speech and text in a Qwen2-0.5B-based model using frozen CLIP ViT-B/32 and Whisper-small encoders with adapters, a three-stage modality-alignment training recipe, delayed parallel text-audio decoding over SNAC token layers, and a command-based ('Stop Omni') semantic interruption mechanism with irq/n-irq status tokens.

title: DocETL: Agentic Query Rewriting and Evaluation for Complex Document Processing
summary: DocETL is a declarative (YAML) system for LLM-powered document processing pipelines that uses LLM agents to apply rewrite directives (e.g., split/gather/map/reduce decomposition, gleaning, resolve), synthesize task-specific validation prompts, and opportunistically select accurate plans, improving accuracy 21-80% over baselines.

title: DocLayout-YOLO: Enhancing Document Layout Analysis through Diverse Synthetic Data and Global-to-Local Adaptive Perception
summary: A YOLOv10-based document layout detector improved by (1) DocSynth-300K, a synthetic pretraining corpus built with the Mesh-candidate BestFit 2D bin-packing layout generation algorithm, and (2) the GL-CRM module (dilated, weight-shared convolutions with learned gating) arranged in a global-to-local hierarchy for multi-scale document elements.

title: D-FINE: Redefine Regression Task in DETRs as Fine-grained Distribution Refinement
summary: D-FINE is a real-time DETR-style object detector that replaces fixed-coordinate bounding box regression with iteratively refined probability distributions (FDR) and distills localization knowledge from the final decoder layer into shallower layers (GO-LSD), improving AP with negligible extra cost.

title: Moonshine: Speech Recognition for Live Transcription and Voice Commands
summary: A family of small encoder-decoder transformer ASR models (Moonshine Tiny/Base) that use RoPE and variable-length, zero-padding-free audio input via a strided conv stem, achieving ~5x lower compute than Whisper tiny.en at comparable WER (paper claim).

title: AutoTrain: No-code training for state-of-the-art models
summary: AutoTrain Advanced is an open-source, no-code library (CLI, UI, Python SDK) that standardizes training/finetuning of Hugging Face Hub models across 22 tasks spanning LLM finetuning, text/token classification, seq2seq, sentence transformers, VLMs, image tasks, and tabular classification/regression, built on Transformers, Datasets, Accelerate, PEFT, TRL, and PyTorch (Sections 1, 3).

title: OmniFlatten: An End-to-end GPT Model for Seamless Voice Conversation
summary: A GPT-based end-to-end full-duplex spoken dialogue model that adapts a text LLM (Qwen2-0.5B) via multi-stage post-training (modality alignment via ASR/TTS, half-duplex dialogue learning, full-duplex dialogue learning on chunked flattened token streams) without architecture changes.

title: Neural Fields in Robotics: A Survey
summary: A survey (not a method paper) reviewing Neural Field representations — Occupancy Networks, Signed Distance Fields, NeRF, and 3D Gaussian Splatting — and their applications across five robotics domains (pose estimation, manipulation, navigation, physics, autonomous driving), with open challenges. Paper facts only; no single architecture is proposed.

title: ThunderKittens: Simple, Fast, and Adorable AI Kernels
summary: ThunderKittens (TK) is a C++ embedded framework of a few opinionated abstractions (16x16 matrix tiles with managed layouts, an asynchronous load-compute-store-finish block template, and grid-level scheduling guidance) for writing high-performance GPU kernels, matching or beating CuBLAS/FlashAttention-3 and Triton baselines on GEMM, attention, linear attention, and state-space-model kernels on H100 GPUs (Sections 1, 3, 4).

title: Precise and Dexterous Robotic Manipulation via Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning
summary: HIL-SERL: a real-world vision-based RL system for dexterous manipulation combining RLPD, pretrained ResNet-10 visual encoders, human demonstrations plus online human corrections, sparse classifier-based rewards, and a separate DQN grasp critic, achieving ~100% success rates in 1-2.5 hours of real-robot training (paraphrase of Sections 1, 3).

title: In-Context LoRA for Diffusion Transformers
summary: The paper shows that text-to-image diffusion transformers (FLUX.1-dev) already possess in-context generation abilities; instead of architectural changes like Group Diffusion Transformers, it concatenates multiple images into one composite image, merges per-image captions into a single prompt, and applies task-specific LoRA tuning on 20-100 image sets to produce coherent image sets (Section 3.3, Section 4.1).

title: Hunyuan-Large: An Open-Source MoE Model with 52 Billion Activated Parameters by Tencent
summary: A 389B-total/52B-activated Transformer MoE LLM with mixed shared/specialized expert routing, recycle routing, GQA+CLA KV-cache compression, expert-specific learning-rate scaling, large-scale synthetic pre-training data, and MoE scaling-law analysis (paper facts, Sections 1-2).

title: Mixture-of-Transformers: A Sparse and Scalable Architecture for Multi-Modal Foundation Models
summary: MoT decouples all non-embedding transformer parameters (FFN, attention Q/K/V/O projections, layer norms) by modality while keeping global self-attention over the full interleaved sequence, matching dense multi-modal baselines with substantially fewer FLOPs (55.8% for text+image, 37.2% with speech, ~1/3 in Transfusion settings).

title: JanusFlow: Harmonizing Autoregression and Rectified Flow for Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation
summary: JanusFlow unifies image understanding and generation in one LLM by training rectified flow inside the autoregressive model, using decoupled vision encoders (SigLIP for understanding, ConvNeXt genc/gdec for generation in SDXL-VAE latent space) plus a representation-alignment regularization (per Sections 3.2-3.4).

title: MagicQuill: An Intelligent Interactive Image Editing System
summary: An interactive image editing system combining a dual-branch diffusion inpainting/control module (Editing Processor), a fine-tuned MLLM that predicts prompts from brush strokes (Painting Assistor, 'Draw&Guess'), and a brush-based UI (Idea Collector).

title: That Chip Has Sailed: A Critique of Unfounded Skepticism Around AI for Chip Design
summary: A position/response paper (not a methods paper) defending AlphaChip, a deep RL chip-placement method, against the Cheng et al. ISPD 2023 reproduction and Markov's meta-analysis, arguing the reproduction omitted pre-training, used far less compute, and did not train to convergence.

title: EchoMimicV2: Towards Striking, Simplified, and Semi-Body Human Animation
summary: An audio-driven half-body human animation framework built on a ReferenceNet-based latent diffusion model, using an Audio-Pose Dynamic Harmonization training strategy (Pose Sampling and Audio Diffusion), Head Partial Attention for headshot data augmentation, and a Phase-specific Denoising Loss, plus the EMTD evaluation benchmark (per paper Sections 1, 3, 4).

title: The Dawn of GUI Agent: A Preliminary Case Study with Claude 3.5 Computer Use
summary: A human-evaluated case study of the API-based Claude 3.5 Computer Use GUI agent across 20 desktop tasks (web search, workflow, office productivity, games), analyzed along planning, action, and critic dimensions, plus an out-of-the-box cross-platform deployment framework (Computer Use OOTB) built on PyAutoGUI. The paper trains nothing; it evaluates a closed-source API model.

title: LLaVA-CoT: Let Vision Language Models Reason Step-by-Step
summary: The paper fine-tunes Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct on a 100k GPT-4o-generated dataset with four structured reasoning stages (summary, caption, reasoning, conclusion) delimited by special tags, and adds a test-time stage-wise retracing search (SWIRES) with a reward model, improving multimodal reasoning benchmarks.

title: OASIS: Open Agent Social Interaction Simulations with One Million Agents
summary: A generalizable, scalable LLM-based agent-based social media simulator (X and Reddit) with environment server, recommendation systems, 21-action agent module, time engine, and distributed scalable inference supporting up to one million agents; it replicates information spreading, group polarization, and herd effects. It is a simulation system, not a trainable neural network model.

title: SAMURAI: Adapting Segment Anything Model for Zero-Shot Visual Tracking with Motion-Aware Memory
summary: A training-free adaptation of SAM 2 for visual object tracking that adds (1) Kalman-filter-based motion modeling to refine mask selection and (2) a motion-aware memory selection mechanism combining mask affinity, object, and motion scores, improving zero-shot tracking on LaSOT, LaSOText, GOT-10k, TrackingNet, NFS, and OTB100.

title: RedPajama: an Open Dataset for Training Large Language Models
summary: The paper releases RedPajama-V1 (an open ~1.2T-token reproduction of the LLaMA training corpus), RedPajama-V2 (100T+ tokens of raw web text with ~46 quality signals per document), and ablation studies with 468M/1.6B decoder-only Llama-2-style models showing quality-signal filtering improves downstream performance. It is a dataset paper, not a novel architecture paper.

title: VBench++: Comprehensive and Versatile Benchmark Suite for Video Generative Models
summary: VBench++ is an evaluation benchmark (not a model) that decomposes video generation quality into 16 disentangled dimensions plus image-to-video and trustworthiness dimensions, each with tailored prompts, evaluation pipelines, and human-preference alignment validation.

title: Marco-o1: Towards Open Reasoning Models for Open-Ended Solutions
summary: Marco-o1 is a Qwen2-7B-Instruct model fine-tuned on filtered/synthetic chain-of-thought data, combined with Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) using token-confidence rewards, action-granularity strategies (steps vs 32/64-token mini-steps), and a self-reflection prompt, improving MGSM math reasoning and slang translation.

title: OminiControl: Minimal and Universal Control for Diffusion Transformer
summary: Reimagines image conditioning in Diffusion Transformers by reusing the base model's VAE encoder and transformer blocks with LoRA fine-tuning (0.1% extra parameters), concatenating condition tokens with image tokens for unified multi-modal attention, and applying dynamic position encoding to handle both spatially-aligned and non-aligned control tasks.

title: XGrammar: Flexible and Efficient Structured Generation Engine for Large Language Models
summary: Introduces XGrammar, a structured generation engine that accelerates context-free grammar constrained decoding for LLMs by splitting the vocabulary into context-independent tokens (precomputed via an adaptive token mask cache) and context-dependent tokens (checked at runtime via a persistent execution stack), with context expansion, automaton optimizations, and CPU-GPU overlap to achieve up to 100x per-token speedup and near-zero overhead in end-

title: DiffusionDrive: Truncated Diffusion Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Introduces a truncated diffusion policy that starts denoising from an anchored Gaussian distribution (K-Means clustered prior anchors) instead of pure Gaussian noise, reducing denoising steps from 20 to 2, and pairs it with a cascade transformer-based diffusion decoder using deformable spatial cross-attention with BEV/PV features for real-time multi-mode end-to-end autonomous driving trajectory planning.

title: Sonic: Shifting Focus to Global Audio Perception in Portrait Animation
summary: Proposes a unified audio-driven portrait animation paradigm that shifts focus from visual motion priors to global audio perception, using context-enhanced audio learning, a motion-decoupled controller, and time-aware position shift fusion to achieve lip-sync, expression diversity, and long-video temporal coherence without motion frames or overlapping latents.

title: O1 Replication Journey – Part 2: Surpassing O1-preview through Simple Distillation, Big Progress or Bitter Lesson?
summary: Demonstrates that supervised fine-tuning a 72B base model on tens of thousands of long-thought-chain samples distilled from O1's API can surpass O1-preview on AIME2024, and proposes a Technical Transparency Index for evaluating O1 replication claims.

title: ShowUI: One Vision-Language-Action Model for GUI Visual Agent
summary: A lightweight 2B vision-language-action model for GUI automation that introduces UI-guided visual token selection via a connected-graph over RGB patches, interleaved vision-language-action streaming for multi-step navigation, and a curated 256K instruction-following dataset, achieving 75.1% zero-shot screenshot grounding.

title: Open-Sora Plan: Open-Source Large Video Generation Model
summary: An open-source video generation framework decomposed into a Wavelet-Flow VAE for latent compression, a Joint Image-Video Skiparse Denoiser (3D DiT with sparse attention), and condition controllers for image/structure control, supported by training strategies (min-max tokens, adaptive gradient clipping, prompt refinement) and a multi-dimensional data curation pipeline.

title: The Well: a Large-Scale Collection of Diverse Physics Simulations for Machine Learning
summary: A 15TB collection of 16 numerical PDE simulation datasets (fluid dynamics, MHD, acoustics, astrophysics, etc.) with a unified HDF5 format, PyTorch interface, and benchmark baselines (FNO, TFNO, U-net, CNextU-net) evaluated with VRMSE on next-snapshot prediction.

title: DEIM: DETR with Improved Matching for Fast Convergence
summary: Introduces DEIM, a training framework for real-time object detection that accelerates convergence by combining Dense One-to-One (O2O) matching via data augmentation with Matchability-Aware Loss (MAL) to optimize low-quality matches.

title: NVILA: Efficient Frontier Visual Language Models
summary: Introduces NVILA, a family of open VLMs using a 'scale-then-compress' paradigm (Dynamic-S2 tiling + spatial/temporal token compression) built on SigLIP + two-layer MLP + Qwen2, with lifecycle-wide efficiency optimizations (FP8 training, DeltaLoss data pruning, ViT-LN fine-tuning, W8A8/W4A16 quantization) achieving frontier accuracy at 1.9–5.1× lower training cost and 1.6–2.8× lower inference latency.

title: Evaluating and Aligning CodeLLMs on Human Preference
summary: Introduces CodeArena, a 397-sample human-curated benchmark across 40 categories and 44 languages for evaluating code-LLM alignment with human preference, and SynCode-Instruct, a ~20B-token synthetic instruction corpus used to fine-tune Qwen2.5-SynCoder as a strong open-source baseline.

title: OmniDocBench: Benchmarking Diverse PDF Document Parsing with Comprehensive Annotations
summary: Introduces a 981-page, 9-document-type benchmark with comprehensive layout, content, and attribute annotations for fair multi-level evaluation of document parsing methods (pipeline tools, expert VLMs, general VLMs), plus a structured evaluation pipeline (extraction, matching, metric calculation).

title: Byte Latent Transformer: Patches Scale Better Than Tokens
summary: Introduces BLT, a tokenizer-free byte-level LLM that dynamically groups bytes into variable-size patches via entropy-based segmentation, using a three-module architecture (lightweight local encoder, large global latent transformer, lightweight local decoder) with cross-attention bridges, achieving parity with tokenization-based models up to 8B parameters while enabling a new scaling axis of simultaneous patch and model growth at fixed inference c

title: AniSora: Exploring the Frontiers of Animation Video Generation in the Sora Era
summary: A unified animation video generation system combining a 10M-clip data pipeline, a DiT-based diffusion model with a spatiotemporal mask module for keyframe interpolation and motion-area control, and a 948-clip benchmark with six animation-specific evaluation metrics.

title: DeepSeek-VL2: Mixture-of-Experts Vision-Language Models for Advanced Multimodal Understanding
summary: Introduces a series of MoE-based Vision-Language Models (1.0B–4.5B activated params) combining a dynamic tiling vision encoder (SigLIP-SO400M-384), a 2-layer MLP VL adaptor, and a DeepSeekMoE LLM with Multi-head Latent Attention, trained in three stages (alignment, pretraining, SFT) on ~800B tokens for tasks including VQA, OCR, document understanding, and visual grounding.

title: MASt3R-SLAM: Real-Time Dense SLAM with 3D Reconstruction Priors
summary: A real-time monocular dense SLAM system built on the MASt3R two-view 3D reconstruction prior, introducing efficient pointmap matching, local fusion, loop closure, and second-order global optimisation to achieve globally consistent poses and dense geometry at 15 FPS without assuming a parametric camera model.

title: 3DGUT: Enabling Distorted Cameras and Secondary Rays in Gaussian Splatting
summary: Replaces the EWA splatting linearization in 3D Gaussian Splatting with the Unscented Transform (UT), approximating 3D Gaussian particles via sigma points that can be projected exactly under any nonlinear camera model. This enables support for distorted cameras, rolling shutter, and alignment with ray-tracing formulations for secondary-ray effects (reflections, refractions) while retaining rasterization efficiency.

title: FastVLM: Efficient Vision Encoding for Vision Language Models
summary: Introduces FastViTHD, a 5-stage hybrid convolution-transformer vision encoder (125.1M params) that downsamples input by 64× to produce few visual tokens, paired with a projection layer and LLM decoder in a LLaVA-1.5 training setup, achieving a superior resolution-latency-accuracy Pareto frontier for VLMs.

title: Qwen2.5 Technical Report
summary: Introduces Qwen2.5, a series of large language models with improved pre-training on 18 trillion tokens and advanced post-training (SFT, DPO, GRPO), offering dense and MoE variants with enhanced long-context and reasoning capabilities.

title: Taming Multimodal Joint Training for High-Quality Video-to-Audio Synthesis
summary: Proposes MMAudio, a multimodal joint-training framework that synthesizes synchronized audio from video and optional text using conditional flow matching over a multimodal transformer (MM-DiT-style blocks with joint attention, aligned RoPE, ConvMLPs, and a conditional synchronization module injecting Synchformer features via per-token adaLN).

title: Align Anything: Training All-Modality Models to Follow Instructions with Language Feedback
summary: Introduces align-anything-200k (first all-modality human preference dataset), the LLF algorithm (learning from language feedback to synthesize preference pairs for DPO/PPO), and eval-anything (all-modality evaluation framework covering understanding and generation).

title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
summary: Introduces a 671B-parameter MoE language model (37B activated) combining Multi-head Latent Attention, DeepSeekMoE with auxiliary-loss-free load balancing, and a Multi-Token Prediction training objective, trained on 14.8T tokens with FP8 mixed precision to achieve state-of-the-art open-source performance at economical cost.

title: LTX-Video: Realtime Video Latent Diffusion
summary: A transformer-based latent diffusion model for text-to-video and image-to-video generation that integrates a high-compression Video-VAE (1:192 ratio, 32×32×8 spatiotemporal downsampling, 128 latent channels) with a denoising transformer, fusing the final denoising step into the VAE decoder to produce pixels directly, achieving faster-than-real-time generation at ~2B parameters.

title: Reconstruction vs. Generation: Taming Optimization Dilemma in Latent Diffusion Models
summary: Introduces VA-VAE, a visual tokenizer aligned with vision foundation models via a novel VF Loss, and LightningDiT, an optimized Diffusion Transformer, to resolve the optimization dilemma between reconstruction and generation.

title: SDPO: Segment-Level Direct Preference Optimization for Social Agents
summary: Proposes segment-level DPO (SDPO) for multi-turn social dialogue alignment: a data pipeline (error localization, positive session sampling from the error turn, segment selection) plus a theoretically grounded loss that eliminates the partition function Z by enforcing equal-length positive/negative segments, evaluated on SOTOPIA.

title: VITA-1.5: Towards GPT-4o Level Real-Time Vision and Speech Interaction
summary: A multimodal LLM integrating vision, language, and speech via a three-stage progressive training strategy (vision-language alignment, audio input tuning, audio output tuning) that enables end-to-end speech-to-speech dialogue without separate ASR/TTS modules while preserving strong vision-language performance.

title: REINFORCE++: A Simple and Efficient Approach for Aligning Large Language Models
summary: Introduces REINFORCE++, a critic-free RLHF framework using Global Advantage Normalization to stabilize training and prevent overfitting compared to local normalization methods like GRPO.

title: PPTAgent: Generating and Evaluating Presentations Beyond Text-to-Slides
summary: Proposes PPTAgent, a two-stage edit-based presentation generation framework (Stage I: slide clustering and schema extraction from a reference deck; Stage II: outline generation plus iterative API-based slide editing with self-correction), and PPTEval, an MLLM-as-a-judge evaluation across Content, Design, and Coherence (Sections 2-3).

title: Sa2VA: Marrying SAM2 with LLaVA for Dense Grounded Understanding of Images and Videos
summary: Unifies SAM-2 (promptable video segmentation) with a pre-trained MLLM (e.g., InternVL2, Qwen-VL) into a single end-to-end model that handles image/video referring segmentation, VQA, grounded caption generation, and visual-prompt understanding via a shared [SEG] token bridge and single-stage instruction tuning.

title: MiniRAG: Towards Extremely Simple Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: MiniRAG is a lightweight RAG system for small language models: a semantic-aware heterogeneous graph index (text chunk nodes + entity nodes, entity-entity and text-attributed entity-chunk edges) plus topology-enhanced graph retrieval (query entity extraction, seed/answer node selection, edge and path scoring, chunk filtering) so SLMs perform RAG comparably to LLM-based methods with ~25% of the storage.

title: Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Survey on Agentic RAG
summary: An analytical survey (not a new model) tracing RAG evolution (naive, advanced, modular, graph, agentic), proposing a taxonomy of Agentic RAG architectures by agent cardinality, control structure, autonomy, and knowledge representation, and distilling design trade-offs, applications, benchmarks, and open challenges.

title: FoundationStereo: Zero-Shot Stereo Matching
summary: A stereo depth foundation model achieving strong zero-shot generalization via a large curated synthetic dataset (FSD, 1M pairs), a Side-Tuning Adapter (STA) that injects frozen DepthAnythingV2 monocular priors into CNN stereo features, and Attentive Hybrid Cost Filtering (AHCF) combining Axial-Planar Convolution (APC) and a Disparity Transformer (DT), followed by GRU-based iterative disparity refinement.

title: PaSa: An LLM Agent for Comprehensive Academic Paper Search
summary: PaSa is a two-agent LLM system (Crawler + Selector) for comprehensive academic paper search, trained with imitation learning and a session-level PPO on the synthetic AutoScholarQuery dataset, evaluated on RealScholarQuery (per paper Sections 1, 4, 5).

title: Gradient-Based Multi-Objective Deep Learning: Algorithms, Theories, Applications, and Beyond
summary: This paper (paper fact) is a survey of gradient-based multi-objective optimization (MOO) methods for deep learning, taxonomizing algorithms into those finding a single balanced solution, a finite Pareto solution set, and a continuous (infinite) Pareto set, plus theory, applications, and resources. No single model is proposed; it is untrusted evidence for algorithm categories, not a buildable architecture.

title: PIKE-RAG: sPecIalized KnowledgE and Rationale Augmented Generation
summary: A RAG framework (per Section 4.1) that organizes corpora into a multi-layer heterogeneous knowledge base, uses knowledge atomizing (atomic question tags per chunk) and knowledge-aware task decomposition to iteratively build rationale for multi-hop QA, plus a trainable decomposer (SFT with LoRA) and a task-difficulty-based capability-level taxonomy (L0–L4).

title: Hunyuan3D 2.0: Scaling Diffusion Models for High Resolution Textured 3D Assets Generation
summary: A two-stage open-source 3D asset generation system: Hunyuan3D-DiT (flow-based diffusion transformer over a ShapeVAE latent space) generates bare meshes from an image, and Hunyuan3D-Paint (geometry-conditioned multi-view diffusion) synthesizes and bakes high-resolution texture maps (Sections 2-4).

title: InternLM-XComposer2.5-Reward: A Simple Yet Effective Multi-Modal Reward Model
summary: The paper augments the InternLM-XComposer2.5 LVLM with a scalar score head on averaged token hidden states, trains it with a pairwise Bradley-Terry-style reward loss on a curated multi-modal (text/image/video) preference corpus, and shows uses for PPO RLHF, best-of-N test-time scaling, and data cleaning.

title: Video Depth Anything: Consistent Depth Estimation for Super-Long Videos
summary: Transforms Depth Anything V2 into a video depth model by adding a lightweight spatiotemporal head with temporal self-attention, a temporal gradient matching (TGM) loss without geometric priors, and a key-frame + overlap interpolation inference strategy for arbitrarily long videos (paper, Sections 3.1-3.3).

title: Continuous 3D Perception Model with Persistent State (CUT3R)
summary: CUT3R is an online 3D perception model: a recurrent transformer that maintains persistent state tokens updated with each incoming image, predicting metric pointmaps, confidence maps, and camera pose per frame in a shared world frame, and can infer unseen regions by querying the state with a raymap.

title: Kimi k1.5: Scaling Reinforcement Learning with LLMs
summary: A technical report describing training of a multimodal LLM with reinforcement learning: long-context RL (128k) with partial rollouts, an online-mirror-descent-style policy optimization without value functions, length penalty, curriculum/prioritized sampling, long2short compression methods, and large-scale RL infrastructure.

title: Fast3R: Towards 3D Reconstruction of 1000+ Images in One Forward Pass
summary: Fast3R extends DUSt3R's pairwise pointmap regression to N unordered, unposed images in a single forward pass, using a ViT-Large encoder, a 24-layer all-to-all fusion transformer with randomized image-index positional embeddings (position interpolation), and two DPT decoding heads predicting local/global pointmaps plus confidence maps (paraphrase of Sections 1, 3.1-3.3).

title: Zep: A Temporal Knowledge Graph Architecture for Agent Memory
summary: Zep is a memory-layer service built on Graphiti, a temporally-aware dynamic knowledge graph engine that ingests conversations and business data into episodic, semantic-entity, and community subgraphs with bi-temporal edge validity, and retrieves context via hybrid search, reranking, and context construction, outperforming MemGPT on DMR and improving accuracy/latency on LongMemEval (Sections 2-4).

title: A Survey of Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Customized Large Language Models
summary: A survey (not a novel model) systematizing GraphRAG: graph-based knowledge organization (index graphs vs. knowledge-carrier graphs vs. hybrid), graph-based retrieval techniques (similarity, logical, GNN, LLM, RL), and knowledge integration (fine-tuning vs. in-context learning), plus benchmarks and open-source systems.

title: Humanity's Last Exam
summary: The paper introduces HLE, a benchmark of 2,500 expert-written, multi-modal, closed-ended academic questions (multiple-choice and exact-match) designed to be far beyond the saturation point of existing LLM benchmarks, plus evaluations showing frontier LLMs score low (roughly 3-13% accuracy) with poor calibration (RMS calibration error 73-89%). It is a dataset/evaluation paper, not a model architecture paper.

title: FireRedASR: Open-Source Industrial-Grade Mandarin Speech Recognition Models from Encoder-Decoder to LLM Integration
summary: A family of open-source Mandarin ASR models: FireRedASR-AED (Conformer encoder + Transformer decoder, 1.1B params) and FireRedASR-LLM (Encoder-Adapter-LLM with Qwen2-7B-Instruct and LoRA, 8.3B params), achieving SOTA Mandarin CER with high-quality manually transcribed data and progressive regularization training.

title: Process Reinforcement through Implicit Rewards
summary: PRIME trains an implicit process reward model (PRM) online using only outcome labels, deriving token-level dense rewards as log-ratios between the PRM and a reference language model, and combines these with outcome rewards in a leave-one-out Monte Carlo advantage estimate (RLOO) with a PPO clip policy loss, eliminating a dedicated reward-modeling stage.

title: VideoRAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Extreme Long-Context Videos
summary: A retrieval-augmented generation framework for unlimited-length videos combining graph-based textual knowledge grounding (VLM captions + ASR transcripts -> LLM-built knowledge graph) with multi-modal context encoding (ImageBind-style clip embeddings), plus a hybrid retrieval paradigm and LLM-based filtering; also introduces the LongerVideos benchmark (164 videos, 134+ hours).

title: SmolLM2: When Smol Goes Big -- Data-Centric Training of a Small Language Model
summary: A 1.7B-parameter Llama2-style language model trained on ~11T tokens via a four-stage, manually rebalanced data mixture, plus three new datasets (FineMath, Stack-Edu, SmolTalk) for math, code, and instruction following, achieving state-of-the-art results among ~1-2B models.

title: Goku: Flow Based Video Generative Foundation Models
summary: A family of rectified-flow Transformers (2B/8B) for joint text-to-image and text-to-video generation, using a 3D image-video VAE shared latent space, full attention, 3D RoPE, Q-K normalization, multi-stage training, and large-scale data curation (per paper Sections 1-2).

title: IndexTTS: An Industrial-Level Controllable and Efficient Zero-Shot Text-To-Speech System
summary: A GPT-style zero-shot TTS system (per Section 2) combining a BPE character-pinyin hybrid tokenizer, an FSQ-based neural speech tokenizer (25 Hz tokens), a decoder-only text-to-codec LLM conditioned by a Conformer/Perceiver speaker encoder (SEQ3 conditioning), and a BigVGAN2 decoder reconstructing 24 kHz audio from LLM latents.

title: MetaChain: A Fully-Automated and Zero-Code Framework for LLM Agents
summary: AutoAgent is a language-driven agent operating system that automatically creates tools, agents, and multi-agent workflows from natural language, evaluated on GAIA and MultiHop-RAG.

title: Self-Supervised Prompt Optimization
summary: SPO is a reference-free prompt optimization framework that iteratively improves prompts via LLM pairwise output comparisons (Output-vs-Output evaluation) and LLM-driven prompt rewriting, achieving competitive performance at ~$0.15 per dataset with only 3 samples per iteration.

title: Can a Single Model Master Both Multi-turn Conversations and Tool Use? CoALM: A Unified Conversational Agentic Language Model
summary: The paper (paper facts) unifies task-oriented dialogue (TOD) and language-agent (LA) function-calling abilities in one fine-tuned LLM family (CoALM 8B/70B/405B, Llama bases) via CoALM-IT, a multi-task instruction dataset mixing SNIPS state tracking, Hammer/ToolACE API calls, and GPT-4o-generated multi-turn ReAct-style SGD conversations (CRA), reporting gains on MultiWOZ 2.4, BFCL V3, and API-Bank.

title: HealthGPT: A Medical Large Vision-Language Model for Unifying Comprehension and Generation via Heterogeneous Knowledge Adaptation
summary: HealthGPT unifies medical visual comprehension and generation in one autoregressive LLM via H-LoRA (task-level hard routing to separate comprehension/generation LoRA plugin sets, each internally a merged multi-expert LoRA with element-wise routing weights), hierarchical visual perception (shallow vs deep ViT features per task type), a three-stage training strategy, and the VL-Health dataset (per Sections 4.1-4.4, 5.1, Appendix A).

title: Large Language Diffusion Models
summary: LLaDA is an 8B masked diffusion language model trained from scratch: a Transformer mask predictor (no causal mask) trained with a 1/t-weighted cross-entropy loss on randomly masked tokens, achieving ARM-competitive scalability, in-context learning, SFT instruction-following, and reversal-curse mitigation (paper Sections 1-3).

title: The Role of World Models in Shaping Autonomous Driving: A Comprehensive Survey
summary: A survey (not a method paper) that taxonomizes Driving World Models (DWMs) by prediction modality (video, point cloud, occupancy, latent, traffic map), reviews simulators/datasets/metrics, applications (simulation, data generation, driving enhancement, pre-training), and reports performance tables for representative methods.

title: Phantom: Subject-consistent video generation via cross-modal alignment
