summary: Defines subject-to-video (S2V) generation and proposes Phantom, a fine-tuned MMDiT video diffusion model that injects reference-image features (VAE latents + CLIP embeddings) into video and text branches with a dynamic window-attention injection scheme, trained on cross-video text-image-video triplets to align text and image conditions without copy-paste leakage or multi-subject confusion.

title: OctoTools: An Agentic Framework with Extensible Tools for Complex Reasoning
summary: A training-free multi-agent framework (per Section 2) that wraps external tools in standardized 'tool cards', uses a planner agent (query analyzer, action predictor, context verifier, solution summarizer) and an executor agent (command generator, command executor), plus a greedy task-specific toolset optimization algorithm; evaluated on 16 reasoning benchmarks.

title: Bitnet.cpp: Efficient Edge Inference for Ternary LLMs
summary: An inference system (Bitnet.cpp) for ternary LLMs (BitNet b1.58) built around a mixed-precision GEMM library with two kernels: TL (element-wise LUT-based, 1.67 bpw) and I2_S (MAD-based, lossless), achieving up to 6.25x speedup over Float16 and lossless inference aligned with BitNet b1.58 training-time quantization (per Section 3, Extracted text block 54).

title: pySLAM: An Open-Source, Modular, and Extensible Framework for SLAM
summary: pySLAM is an open-source Python Visual SLAM framework (Sections 1-3) supporting mono/stereo/RGB-D cameras, with modular, swappable components for feature tracking/matching, loop closure, depth estimation, volumetric integration (TSDF, Gaussian Splatting), and semantic mapping, plus standardized dataset handling and evaluation tooling (Sections 4-5).

title: YOLOv12: Attention-Centric Real-Time Object Detectors
summary: An attention-centric YOLO detector family (N/S/M/L/X) that combines area attention (A2), residual efficient layer aggregation networks (R-ELAN), and attention-friendly architectural tweaks (Conv+BN projections, no positional encoding, MLP ratio 1.2/2, 7x7 position perceiver, FlashAttention) to match CNN-based YOLO speed while improving COCO mAP (paper Sections 3-4).

title: AIDE: AI-Driven Exploration in the Space of Code
summary: AIDE is an LLM-powered agent that frames machine learning engineering as code-space optimization, using a hard-coded tree search over candidate Python scripts with drafting, debugging, and improving operators guided by automated evaluation (Sections 3.1-3.2).

title: MoBA: Mixture of Block Attention for Long-Context LLMs
summary: The paper proposes MoBA, a block-sparse attention mechanism that applies MoE-style top-k gating to attention: the context is partitioned into KV blocks, a gate computes query-block affinity via mean-pooled keys (Eq. 6), selects top-k blocks with causal masking, and attention is computed per selected block (with causal masking within the current block), combined via online softmax. It matches full-attention scaling while being sub-quadratic and su

title: Qwen2.5-VL Technical Report
summary: A vision-language model family combining a redesigned ViT with window attention and native dynamic resolution, an MLP vision-language merger, and a Qwen2.5 LLM with MRoPE aligned to absolute time, trained on ~4.1T tokens across three pre-training stages plus SFT/DPO post-training (per paper Sections 2.1-2.3).

title: S*: Test Time Scaling for Code Generation
summary: A hybrid test-time scaling framework for code generation that combines parallel sampling with sequential iterative debugging (grounded in public-test execution feedback) and an adaptive input-synthesis selection stage that pairwise-compares candidate solutions using real execution outputs (Sections 3, Fig. 2, Algorithm 1).

title: SigLIP 2: Multilingual Vision-Language Encoders with Improved Semantic Understanding, Localization, and Dense Features
summary: A family of multilingual CLIP-style vision-language encoders (ViT-B/16 to g/16) that extends the SigLIP sigmoid contrastive loss with LocCa decoder-based captioning/localization pretraining, SILC/TIPS self-distillation and masked-prediction losses, NaFlex native-aspect-ratio variable-resolution variants, and ACID active data curation for small models (Sections 1-2).

title: From RAG to Memory: Non-Parametric Continual Learning for Large Language Models
summary: HippoRAG 2 (per Section 3 of the paper): a non-parametric continual-learning RAG framework that builds a schema-less knowledge graph offline (LLM OpenIE triples, embedding-based synonym edges, passage nodes with 'contains' context edges) and retrieves online via query-to-triple embedding matching, LLM recognition-memory triple filtering, and Personalized PageRank over phrase and passage seed nodes, outperforming standard RAG on factual, sense-mak

title: olmOCR: Unlocking Trillions of Tokens in PDFs with Vision Language Models
summary: An open toolkit (olmOCR) that converts PDFs to linearized plain text using document-anchoring prompts and a 7B VLM (Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct) fine-tuned on GPT-4o-generated silver data (olmOCR-mix-0225), plus a unit-test-style benchmark (olmOCR-Bench) showing state-of-the-art extraction quality at low cost.

title: TheoremExplainAgent: Towards Multimodal Explanations for LLM Theorem Understanding
summary: The paper proposes an agentic LLM pipeline (planner agent + coding agent with agentic RAG over Manim docs) that generates long-form theorem explanation videos, plus TheoremExplainBench (240 theorems, 4 STEM disciplines) with 5 automated evaluation metrics. It is an inference-time agentic system, not a trainable neural architecture.

title: LLM Post-Training: A Deep Dive into Reasoning Large Language Models
summary: A survey/tutorial systematizing LLM post-training into fine-tuning, reinforcement learning (reward modeling, PPO, DPO, GRPO, ORPO, OREO), and test-time scaling (beam search, best-of-N, CoT, ToT, MCTS), with benchmarks and open challenges. It is a survey, not a single novel architecture.

title: DiffRhythm: Blazingly Fast and Embarrassingly Simple End-to-End Full-Length Song Generation with Latent Diffusion
summary: A latent-diffusion (flow-matching) song generation system: a music VAE compresses 44.1kHz stereo audio into 64-channel latents at 21.5Hz, and a DiT built from LLaMA-style decoder layers denoises latents conditioned on style prompt, timestep, and sentence-level-aligned lyric phoneme tokens, generating full songs (up to 4m45s) non-autoregressively (Sections 3.1-3.4).

title: Spark-TTS: An Efficient LLM-Based Text-to-Speech Model with Single-Stream Decoupled Speech Tokens
summary: Proposes BiCodec, a single-stream speech codec producing low-bitrate semantic tokens (50 TPS) plus fixed-length (32) global tokens, and Spark-TTS, a Qwen2.5-0.5B decoder-only LLM fine-tuned on these tokens with chain-of-thought attribute control (gender, pitch, speed) for zero-shot and controllable TTS, plus the VoxBox 100k-hour annotated dataset.

title: EAGLE-3: Scaling up Inference Acceleration of Large Language Models via Training-Time Test
summary: EAGLE-3 is a speculative-decoding draft model that removes the feature-prediction loss, directly predicts tokens, fuses low/mid/high-layer target-model features via an FC layer, and simulates multi-step generation during training (training-time test), yielding up to 6.5x speedup and a new data-scaling law for inference acceleration (Sections 1, 3, 4).

title: Vision-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: A reasoning MLLM built by cold-start SFT on a 200K human-annotation-free multimodal CoT dataset (produced via Modality Bridging with an MLLM plus DeepSeek-R1), followed by GRPO reinforcement learning with a hard formatting result reward and Progressive Thinking Suppression Training (PTST) that first constrains then relaxes reasoning length to fix an overthinking optimization problem.

title: A Comprehensive Survey of Mixture-of-Experts: Algorithms, Theory, and Applications
summary: A survey (not a single novel architecture) covering MoE basics (gating functions, expert networks, routing, training strategies, system design), MoE across learning paradigms, theory, and CV/NLP applications.

title: YOLOE: Real-Time Seeing Anything
summary: A unified YOLO-based open-vocabulary detector/segmenter supporting text prompts (RepRTA), visual prompts (SAVPE), and prompt-free retrieval (LRPC) with low training and inference cost (per paper Sections 1, 3).

title: VACE: All-in-One Video Creation and Editing
summary: VACE unifies video generation and editing tasks (reference-to-video, video-to-video editing, masked editing, and their compositions) in one Diffusion Transformer via a Video Condition Unit input paradigm, concept decoupling, and a pluggable Context Adapter (Res-Tuning style) added to a pre-trained text-to-video DiT (per Sections 3.1-3.3).

title: YuE: Scaling Open Foundation Models for Long-Form Music Generation
summary: YuE is a two-stage LLaMA2-based autoregressive LM family for lyrics-to-song generation up to five minutes, using track-decoupled next-token prediction (separate vocal/accompaniment tokens), structural progressive conditioning (segment-interleaved lyrics/audio 'CoT'), redesigned music in-context learning with delayed activation, and a multitask multiphase pre-training recipe over trillions of tokens (Section 3, Section 4).

title: Search-R1: Training LLMs to Reason and Leverage Search Engines with Reinforcement Learning
summary: An RL framework (PPO/GRPO) that trains LLMs to interleave reasoning with multi-turn search-engine calls, using retrieved-token loss masking and a simple exact-match outcome reward.

title: Open-Sora 2.0: Training a Commercial-Level Video Generation Model in $200k
summary: Paraphrase of the paper: Open-Sora 2.0 is an open-source video generation model (Video DC-AE autoencoder plus a Flux-initialized MMDiT diffusion transformer trained with flow matching) trained for about $200k via hierarchical data filtering, multi-stage low-to-high-resolution training, and systems optimizations, achieving results comparable to HunyuanVideo and Runway Gen-3 Alpha. This summary paraphrases the paper's claims; they are not verified

title: VisualPRM: An Effective Process Reward Model for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: The paper introduces VisualPRM, an 8B multimodal Process Reward Model trained on VisualPRM400K (Monte-Carlo-estimated step correctness labels) that serves as a critic for Best-of-N test-time scaling of MLLMs, plus VisualProcessBench for evaluating step-error detection.

title: AudioX: Diffusion Transformer for Anything-to-Audio Generation
summary: A unified Diffusion Transformer framework (AudioX) that generates audio/music from flexible combinations of text, video, and audio conditions via a lightweight Multimodal Adaptive Fusion (MAF) module, trained on a new 7M-sample multimodal caption dataset (IF-caps).

title: LHM: Large Animatable Human Reconstruction Model from a Single Image in Seconds
summary: A feed-forward multimodal transformer (MBHT) that fuses SMPL-X surface point tokens with Sapiens/DINOv2 image tokens to regress canonical 3D Gaussian splatting parameters of an animatable human avatar from one image, trained self-supervised on ~300K video sequences with photometric and canonical-space regularization losses (Sections 1, 4).

title: TikZero: Zero-Shot Text-Guided Graphics Program Synthesis
summary: TikZero decouples TikZ graphics program generation from text understanding: an inverse-graphics VLM (SigLIP vision encoder + LLaMA decoder) is trained on graphics programs, and a cross-attention adapter distilled from caption embeddings to mimic vision-encoder patch embeddings is trained independently on captioned images, enabling zero-shot text-guided program synthesis; TikZero+ adds optional fine-tuning on the small caption-program intersection

title: SmolDocling: An ultra-compact vision-language model for end-to-end multi-modal document conversion
summary: A 256M-parameter vision-language model (SmolVLM-256M based) that converts document page images end-to-end into DocTags markup capturing content, structure, and location, plus new datasets (charts, code, equations) and the DocTags format (paper Sections 1, 3).

title: ReCamMaster: Camera-Controlled Generative Rendering from A Single Video
summary: A camera-controlled video re-rendering framework that regenerates an input video at novel camera trajectories by conditioning a pre-trained text-to-video latent diffusion model via frame-dimension token concatenation, per-block camera-pose injection, a synthetic UE5 multi-camera dataset, and task-unifying training strategies (paper, Secs. 3-5).

title: VGGT: Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer
summary: A ~1.2B-parameter feed-forward transformer (per Sec. 3.2/3.3) that takes one to hundreds of RGB images and jointly predicts camera parameters, depth maps, point maps, and 3D point tracks in a single forward pass, using alternating frame-wise/global self-attention and multi-task training, outperforming optimization-based 3D reconstruction baselines without post-processing.

title: Training Video Foundation Models with NVIDIA NeMo
summary: An end-to-end, scalable open-source pipeline (NeMo Curator, Megatron Energon, Megatron Core) for curating petabyte-scale video data, multimodal dataloading, and 4D-parallel (TP/FSDP/CP/PP) training and inference of video diffusion transformers (DiT/ST-DiT), with algorithm-system co-design such as AdaLN-LoRA and hybrid parallelism.

title: DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale
summary: Proposes DAPO (Decoupled Clip and Dynamic sAmpling Policy Optimization), a GRPO-style RL algorithm with four techniques (Clip-Higher, Dynamic Sampling, Token-Level Policy Gradient Loss, Overlong Reward Shaping) that trains Qwen2.5-32B to 50 points on AIME 2024, with open-sourced verl-based code and the DAPO-Math-17K dataset.

title: Aligning Multimodal LLM with Human Preference: A Survey
summary: A survey (not a method paper) that taxonomizes MLLM alignment algorithms by application scenario, dataset construction, evaluation benchmarks, and future directions, with a unified notation for preference-optimization losses (Section 3, Table 1).

title: GR00T N1: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Humanoid Robots
summary: An open 2.2B-parameter Vision-Language-Action foundation model for humanoid robots combining a pre-trained VLM (System 2, Eagle-2) with a diffusion-transformer flow-matching action head (System 1), jointly trained end-to-end on a heterogeneous data pyramid of real robot trajectories, simulation data, neural-generated videos, and human videos with latent/IDM pseudo-actions.

title: InfiniteYou: Flexible Photo Recrafting While Preserving Your Identity
summary: Proposes InfU, a DiT-based (FLUX.1-dev) identity-preserved text-to-image framework where an InfuseNet branch (a ControlNet generalization) injects projected face-identity features into the frozen DiT via residual connections, trained with Conditional Flow Matching in two stages (pretraining on real SPSS data, then SFT on synthetic SPMS data).

title: PP-DocLayout: A Unified Document Layout Detection Model to Accelerate Large-Scale Data Construction
summary: A unified document layout detection model family (PP-DocLayout-L/M/S) recognizing 23 layout region types across diverse document formats, combining knowledge distillation (Vary-ViT-B teacher into PP-HGNetV2-B4 backbone), semi-supervised pseudo-labeling with adaptive per-class thresholds, and RT-DETR/PicoDet detectors for real-time inference (paper Sections 3-4).

title: AgentRxiv: Towards Collaborative Autonomous Research
summary: The paper introduces AgentRxiv, a centralized preprint server that lets autonomous LLM agent laboratories (built on Agent Laboratory) upload, search, and retrieve each other's research reports, enabling cumulative and parallel collaborative research; agents tasked with improving MATH-500 accuracy via reasoning/prompting techniques improved from 70.2% to 78.2% (sequential) and 79.8% (parallel), with the discovered SDA technique generalizing across

title: SimpleRL-Zoo: Investigating and Taming Zero Reinforcement Learning for Open Base Models in the Wild
summary: An empirical study of zero RL training (GRPO with rule-based correctness reward, no SFT cold start) across 10 diverse open base models, identifying key factors (no format reward, data difficulty matching, exploration hyperparameters) and showing genuine reasoning gains beyond reranking.

title: Open Deep Search: Democratizing Search with Open-source Reasoning Agents
summary: An open-source search-AI framework (ODS) that augments any base LLM with two components: an Open Search Tool (query rephrasing, SERP retrieval, webpage scraping, chunking, re-ranking) and an Open Reasoning Agent (ReAct-based ODS-v1 or CodeAct-based ODS-v2) that adaptively orchestrates search, calculator, and reasoning tools, achieving state-of-the-art SimpleQA and FRAMES accuracy with open LLMs.

title: Qwen2.5-Omni Technical Report
summary: An end-to-end multimodal model (text, image, audio, video) that streams text and speech outputs via a Thinker-Talker architecture, TMRoPE time-aligned position embeddings, block-wise encoders, and a sliding-window DiT vocoder (paraphrased from Sections 1-2).

title: Wan: Open and Advanced Large-Scale Video Generative Models
summary: An open suite of diffusion-transformer video generation models (1.3B and 14B) built on flow matching, with a novel 3D causal spatio-temporal VAE (Wan-VAE), umT5 text conditioning, large-scale data curation, distributed training strategies, inference acceleration, and downstream tasks (I2V, editing, personalization, camera control, real-time streaming, audio generation).

title: Large Language Model Agent: A Survey on Methodology, Applications and Challenges
summary: A methodology-centered survey taxonomy of LLM agent systems organized around construction (profile, memory, planning, action), collaboration (centralized, decentralized, hybrid), and evolution (self-learning, co-evolution, external resources), plus evaluation, tools, security/privacy issues, and applications. It is a survey, not a trainable model paper; no architecture, weights, training objective, or results are proposed by the authors themselve

title: Open-Reasoner-Zero: An Open Source Approach to Scaling Up Reinforcement Learning on the Base Model
summary: The paper (per 'Extracted text block 4') presents Open-Reasoner-Zero, an open-source recipe for large-scale reasoning RL directly on base LLMs: vanilla PPO with GAE(λ=1, γ=1), rule-based binary rewards, no KL regularization, and a curated ~57k diverse dataset, achieving strong benchmark results with ~1/10 the training steps of DeepSeek-R1-Zero.

title: Agent S2: A Compositional Generalist-Specialist Framework for Computer Use Agents
summary: A compositional agent framework that delegates planning (Manager), action generation (Worker), and GUI localization (Mixture of Grounding experts) across generalist and specialist models, with Proactive Hierarchical Planning that replans after each subgoal.

title: AIBrix: Towards Scalable, Cost-Effective Large Language Model Inference Infrastructure
summary: AIBrix is a cloud-native infrastructure framework (not a model) for LLM serving: high-density LoRA management, LLM-specific autoscaling, prefix/load-aware gateway routing, distributed KV cache, hybrid Kubernetes/Ray orchestration, SLO-driven heterogeneous GPU serving, and accelerator diagnostics. It reports system-level gains (e.g., ~50% throughput, ~70% TTFT reduction with distributed KV cache) rather than a new neural architecture.

title: FantasyTalking: Realistic Talking Portrait Generation via Coherent Motion Synthesis
summary: A dual-stage audio-visual alignment strategy (clip-level then lip-masked frame-level) adapting a pretrained Wan2.1 video diffusion transformer for talking-portrait video generation, with facial-focused cross-attention identity preservation (ArcFace+Q-Former) and a motion intensity modulation network controlling expression/body movement amplitude.

title: One-Minute Video Generation with Test-Time Training
summary: Adds Test-Time Training (TTT) layers — RNN layers whose hidden state is a trainable two-layer MLP updated by inner-loop gradient steps on a self-supervised reconstruction loss — into a pre-trained Diffusion Transformer (CogVideo-X 5B), with learned gating and bi-directional scanning, then multi-stage fine-tunes it to generate one-minute multi-scene videos from text storyboards (per Sections 2–3).

title: TAPNext: Tracking Any Point (TAP) as Next Token Prediction
summary: Casts point tracking in video as masked token decoding: image patch tokens and query-derived point track tokens are jointly processed by interleaved temporal SSM (RecurrentGemma-style) and spatial ViT blocks (TRecViT backbone), with per-layer coordinate-classification and visibility heads, achieving state-of-the-art online TAP without tracking-specific inductive biases (Section 3).

title: Skywork R1V: Pioneering Multimodal Reasoning with Chain-of-Thought
summary: A 38B-parameter multimodal reasoning model that transfers DeepSeek-R1-distill-Qwen2.5-32B reasoning to vision via a lightweight MLP projector aligned to a ViT encoder, trained with a hybrid iterative-SFT + GRPO framework and adaptive-length chain-of-thought distillation, without retraining the vision encoder or language model (per Sections 2.1-2.3).

title: OmniSVG: A Unified Scalable Vector Graphics Generation Model
summary: A unified autoregressive SVG generator built on a pre-trained VLM (Qwen2.5-VL) that parameterizes SVG commands/coordinates/colors into discrete tokens, plus the MMSVG-2M dataset and MMSVG-Bench evaluation protocol (paper facts).

title: VLM-R1: A Stable and Generalizable R1-style Large Vision-Language Model
summary: A GRPO-based reinforcement learning framework (VLM-R1) that improves vision-language models on grounding tasks (REC, OVD) using rule-based rewards, showing RL generalizes better than SFT, plus insights on reward hacking (odLength reward), data selection, and model scaling.

title: The AI Scientist-v2: Workshop-Level Automated Scientific Discovery via Agentic Tree Search
summary: An end-to-end agentic system that generates research ideas, runs experiments via parallelized agentic tree search with an experiment manager, uses VLM feedback on figures, and autonomously writes manuscripts; one AI-generated paper passed ICLR workshop peer review.

title: UltraRAG: A Modular and Automated Toolkit for Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: A modular RAG toolkit (paper facts) covering data construction, training (SFT/DPO), evaluation, and inference workflows, with knowledge adaptation demonstrated on a legal-domain case study using MiniCPM models.

title: InternVL3: Exploring Advanced Training and Test-Time Recipes for Open-Source Multimodal Models
summary: InternVL3 is a family of multimodal LLMs (ViT + MLP + LLM) trained with a native multimodal pre-training paradigm that jointly optimizes all parameters on interleaved text and multimodal data, plus V2PE position encoding, SFT/MPO post-training, and test-time scaling with a process reward model (paraphrase of Sections 1-2).

title: One Model to Rig Them All: Diverse Skeleton Rigging with UniRig
summary: UniRig is a two-stage learning framework for automatic skeletal rigging of diverse 3D models: (1) an autoregressive OPT-based transformer generates topologically valid skeleton trees via a novel Skeleton Tree Tokenization, and (2) a Bone-Point Cross Attention module predicts skinning weights and bone attributes, trained on the new Rig-XL dataset (14,611 rigged models) plus VRoid.

title: BrowseComp: A Simple Yet Challenging Benchmark for Browsing Agents
summary: A benchmark of 1,266 human-authored questions requiring persistent web browsing to find hard-to-locate, entangled facts, with short, easily verifiable answers; includes human baseline (29.2%) and model evaluations (Deep Research 51.5%).

title: Packing Input Frame Context in Next-Frame Prediction Models for Video Generation
summary: FramePack: a next-frame-section video diffusion structure that progressively compresses input frame contexts by frame importance (time proximity or feature similarity) so total context length converges to a fixed bound, plus anti-drifting sampling (endpoint planning, inverted order) and history discretization training.

title: SkyReels-V2: Infinite-length Film Generative Model
summary: A film-style video generation system combining a structured video captioner (SkyCaptioner-V1), progressive-resolution flow-matching DiT pretraining, motion-focused DPO reinforcement learning, and a diffusion-forcing post-training adaptation with non-decreasing noise schedules to enable very long / infinite-length video generation.

title: Perception Encoder: The best visual embeddings are not at the output of the network
summary: A contrastively pretrained vision encoder family (PEcore/PElang/PEspatial) whose strong general features live in intermediate layers; alignment tuning (to an LLM for language tasks, to self-features plus SAM 2.1 mask logits for spatial tasks) lifts them to the output.

title: UFO2: The Desktop AgentOS
summary: UFO2 is a multiagent Windows desktop automation system (AgentOS) with a centralized HostAgent, application-specialized AppAgents, hybrid UIA+vision control detection, a unified GUI-API action layer, retrieval-augmented knowledge, speculative multi-action execution, and a Picture-in-Picture virtual desktop. It is an LLM-orchestration system, not a trainable neural architecture.

title: EasyEdit2: An Easy-to-use Steering Framework for Editing Large Language Models
summary: EasyEdit2 is a plug-and-play test-time steering framework for LLMs built around a steering vector generator (e.g., CAA, STA, SAE-feature, prompt-based) and a steering vector applier that adds scaled vectors to activations during the forward pass without modifying model weights, plus a vector library with Linear/TIES/DARE-TIES merging, datasets, and evaluators modules.

title: Describe Anything: Detailed Localized Image and Video Captioning
summary: The paper introduces DAM, a vision-language model for detailed localized image/video captioning built on a focal prompt (full image + expanded focal crop, each with a mask) and a localized vision backbone with gated cross-attention adapters, plus an SSL data pipeline (DLC-SDP) and a reference-free benchmark (DLC-Bench).

title: DreamO: A Unified Framework for Image Customization
summary: DreamO (per Sections 1-3) is a unified image-customization framework built on a pre-trained Flux DiT: condition images are VAE-encoded and concatenated with text and noisy-latent tokens in one sequence, LoRA adapters are trained with a feature routing constraint on cross-attention maps, a placeholder strategy binds [ref#i] tokens to condition images, and a three-stage progressive training schedule restores generation quality.

title: Paper2Code: Automating Code Generation from Scientific Papers in Machine Learning
summary: PaperCoder is a multi-agent LLM framework that converts ML papers into code repositories via three stages (planning, analysis, coding), evaluated on Paper2CodeBench and PaperBench Code-Dev with model-based and human evaluations.

title: Demonstrating Berkeley Humanoid Lite: An Open-source, Accessible, and Customizable 3D-printed Humanoid Robot
summary: Introduces Berkeley Humanoid Lite, an open-source mid-scale humanoid robot built from 3D-printed cycloidal-gear actuators and off-the-shelf parts (under $5,000), validates actuator durability/efficiency, and demonstrates an RL locomotion policy with zero-shot sim-to-real transfer plus teleoperated manipulation (paper fact, Abstract and Sections I, IV, V).

title: Step1X-Edit: A Practical Framework for General Image Editing
summary: An open-source instruction-based image editing model combining an MLLM (Qwen-VL) with a DiT diffusion decoder via a connector/token-refiner, trained on a 1M-pair pipeline covering 11 editing tasks, plus the GEdit-Bench evaluation benchmark (paraphrased from Abstract and Section 3).

title: Collaborating Action by Action: A Multi-agent LLM Framework for Embodied Reasoning
summary: The paper introduces MINDcraft, a Minecraft-based platform where LLM agents control characters via 47 parameterized tools, and MineCollab, a benchmark of cooking, crafting, and construction tasks testing multi-agent embodied collaboration. It finds communication quality is the main bottleneck (performance drops over 15% when detailed plans must be communicated) and provides an SFT dataset pipeline from successful oracle-agent trajectories.

title: Kimi-Audio Technical Report
summary: An open-source audio foundation model combining a 12.5Hz hybrid audio tokenizer (discrete semantic tokens plus continuous Whisper acoustic features), an LLM-based audio model with shared layers and parallel text/audio heads, and a chunk-wise flow-matching detokenizer, pre-trained on ~13M hours of audio with audio-text interleaving tasks and fine-tuned for ASR, audio understanding, chat, and speech conversation.

title: Mem0: Building Production-Ready AI Agents with Scalable Long-Term Memory
summary: The paper proposes Mem0, an LLM-orchestrated memory pipeline that extracts candidate facts from message pairs, resolves them against a vector-embedding memory store via ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NOOP tool calls, and an extension Mem0g that stores entities and relationship triplets in a directed labeled graph (Neo4j). Evaluation on LOCOMO reports higher LLM-as-a-Judge scores and much lower latency/token cost than full-context and RAG baselines.

title: RAGEN: Understanding Self-Evolution in LLM Agents via Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
summary: The paper proposes StarPO, a trajectory-level RL framework for training LLM agents over multi-turn stochastic environments, and RAGEN, a training/evaluation system. It identifies an instability mode (Echo Trap) and proposes StarPO-S with uncertainty-based trajectory filtering, critic baselining, and gradient shaping (KL removal, asymmetric clipping).

title: In-Context Edit: Enabling Instructional Image Editing with In-Context Generation in Large Scale Diffusion Transformer
summary: ICEdit (per the paper) enables instruction-based image editing on a large pretrained diffusion transformer (FLUX.1 Fill) via an in-context diptych prompt format, minimal LoRA / LoRA-MoE fine-tuning (~0.2B trainable params, 50K samples), and VLM-based early-filter inference-time noise selection, achieving SOTA-comparable editing with 0.1% of prior training data.

title: WebThinker: Empowering Large Reasoning Models with Deep Research Capability
summary: WebThinker (per Section 3.2 and Appendix A) is an agentic framework that lets a large reasoning model autonomously call web-search/navigation tools (Deep Web Explorer) and report drafting/checking/editing tools during its chain-of-thought, plus iterative online DPO training on tool-usage preference pairs. This is an agent orchestration and preference-tuning system, not a numeric tensor graph.

title: Absolute Zero: Reinforced Self-play Reasoning with Zero Data
summary: Proposes the Absolute Zero paradigm where a single LLM acts as both proposer and solver of self-generated code reasoning tasks (deduction, abduction, induction), verified by a Python executor, trained with Task-Relative REINFORCE++ (TRR++) without any human-curated data.

title: Generating Physically Stable and Buildable LEGO Designs from Text
summary: BrickGPT fine-tunes an autoregressive LLM (LLaMA-3.2-1B-Instruct) to predict brick-by-brick LEGO structures from text prompts in a compact textual format, using a new StableText2Brick dataset (47k+ stable structures) plus inference-time validity checks, rejection sampling, and physics-aware rollback to guarantee stability.

title: Flow-GRPO: Training Flow Matching Models via Online RL
summary: Integrates online policy-gradient RL (GRPO) into flow matching text-to-image models via (1) an ODE-to-SDE conversion that injects stochasticity while preserving marginals, and (2) a Denoising Reduction strategy using few denoising steps during training while keeping full steps at inference, with KL regularization to limit reward hacking.

title: Continuous Thought Machines
summary: The paper (paper facts) introduces the CTM, a recurrent architecture that models neuron-level temporal dynamics via privately-parameterized neuron-level models (NLMs) over histories of pre-activations, and uses neural synchronization (decayed inner products of post-activation histories, sampled neuron pairs) as the latent representation for cross-attention queries and predictions, plus a certainty-based loss over internal ticks enabling adaptive

title: Seed1.5-VL Technical Report
summary: Paraphrase (paper fact): ByteDance presents Seed1.5-VL, a vision-language foundation model combining a 532M-parameter native-resolution ViT (Seed-ViT), an MLP adapter, and a 20B-active-parameter MoE LLM, trained via a three-stage pre-training recipe and extensive post-training (SFT, RLHF, RLVR, hybrid PPO), achieving state-of-the-art results on 38 of 60 public benchmarks including GUI-agent and gameplay tasks.

title: INTELLECT-2: A Reasoning Model Trained Through Globally Decentralized Reinforcement Learning
summary: First globally distributed, permissionless asynchronous RL run of a 32B reasoning model (fine-tuning QwQ-32B with GRPO variants), enabled by purpose-built infrastructure: PRIME-RL (async train/inference separation), SHARDCAST (weight broadcast CDN), TOPLOC (verifiable inference via locality-sensitive hashing of hidden states), plus GRPO stability modifications (two-sided clipping, aggressive gradient clipping, offline/online data filtering, lengt

title: MiMo: Unlocking the Reasoning Potential of Language Model -- From Pretraining to Posttraining
summary: MiMo-7B is a 7B decoder-only LLM optimized for reasoning: reasoning-dense pre-training data with a three-stage mixture over ~25T tokens, a Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) auxiliary objective, and GRPO-based RL on 130K verifiable math/code problems with test-difficulty-driven rewards and easy-data resampling.

title: DanceGRPO: Unleashing GRPO on Visual Generation
summary: Adapts Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to visual generation by reformulating diffusion and rectified-flow sampling as stochastic differential equations within an MDP, enabling stable RL fine-tuning across text-to-image, text-to-video, and image-to-video tasks with multiple reward models (paper facts).

title: Qwen3 Technical Report
summary: Qwen3 is a family of open-weight dense and MoE LLMs (0.6B–235B parameters) that unifies thinking and non-thinking modes in one model with thinking-budget control, pre-trained on 36T tokens across 119 languages, post-trained via a four-stage pipeline (long-CoT cold start, reasoning RL, thinking mode fusion, general RL), with strong-to-weak distillation for small models.

title: BLIP3-o: A Family of Fully Open Unified Multimodal Models—Architecture, Training and Dataset
summary: The paper systematically studies design choices (image representation: CLIP vs VAE; objective: flow matching vs MSE; strategy: joint vs sequential training) for unified image understanding/generation, and introduces BLIP3-o: a frozen Qwen2.5-VL autoregressive backbone plus a Lumina-Next DiT trained with flow matching to generate CLIP image features, with sequential two-stage training and a curated 60k instruction-tuning set (per Sections 3–5).

title: Group-in-Group Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training
summary: GiGPO is a critic-free group-based RL algorithm for multi-turn LLM agent training that combines episode-level (GRPO-style) relative advantages with step-level advantages computed by retroactively grouping actions taken at repeated 'anchor' environment states across trajectories, yielding fine-grained credit assignment without extra rollouts or value models.

title: Meta-World+: An Improved, Standardized, RL Benchmark
summary: The paper re-engineers the Meta-World multi-task/meta-RL benchmark with explicit V1/V2 reward versioning, Gymnasium compatibility, new MT25/ML25 and custom task sets, and shows empirically that reward-scale inconsistencies invalidated cross-version algorithm comparisons (Sections 1, 5, 6).

title: SageAttention3: Microscaling FP4 Attention for Inference and An Exploration of 8-Bit Training
summary: Proposes SageAttention3, a microscaling FP4 (NVFP4) attention kernel for Blackwell GPU inference acceleration, and SageBwd, an INT8 attention with FP16-retained dOV^T for trainable low-bit attention; fine-tuning is lossless but pretraining converges slower (Sections 3-5).

title: Decompile-Bench: Million-Scale Binary-Source Function Pairs for Real-World Binary Decompilation
summary: The paper introduces Decompile-Bench, a two-million-pair binary-source function dataset built via a Compile-Trace-Filter (CTF) pipeline from permissively licensed GitHub C/C++ projects, plus a leakage-resistant evaluation suite (Decompile-Bench-Eval). Fine-tuning LLM4Decompile-End on this data reportedly improves re-executability by over 20% versus prior benchmarks (Sections 3-5).

title: MAGI-1: Autoregressive Video Generation at Scale
summary: MAGI-1 is a 4.5B/24B-parameter diffusion transformer that generates video autoregressively chunk-by-chunk (24 frames per chunk) in a latent space, trained with flow matching under monotonically increasing per-chunk noise, enabling streaming, video continuation, image-to-video, and chunk-wise text control under one training objective (paper facts, Sections 1-2).

title: Faster Video Diffusion with Trainable Sparse Attention
summary: The paper proposes VSA, a trainable, hardware-aligned two-stage sparse attention for video diffusion transformers: a coarse stage pools tokens into (4,4,4) cubes to predict critical tiles via Top-K, and a fine stage computes block-sparse token attention only in selected tiles, combined through learned gates. It reports 2.53x training FLOPS reduction and 6x attention speedup when retrofitted into Wan2.1 (paper claims, Sections 1-3).

title: Dolphin: Document Image Parsing via Heterogeneous Anchor Prompting
summary: A two-stage (analyze-then-parse) vision-language document parsing model: Stage 1 generates a reading-order layout element sequence from the page image; Stage 2 crops each element and parses content in parallel using type-specific prompts, trained on 30M multi-granularity samples.

title: MMaDA: Multimodal Large Diffusion Language Models
summary: A unified discrete-diffusion foundation model (mask token prediction over text and image tokens) with mixed long chain-of-thought fine-tuning and a diffusion-tailored policy-gradient RL algorithm (UniGRPO) for post-training across textual reasoning, multimodal understanding, and text-to-image generation.

title: Speechless: Speech Instruction Training Without Speech for Low Resource Languages
summary: A three-stage pipeline that trains a residual vector quantizer over frozen Whisper encoder outputs, then a 1B decoder-only LM that maps text to semantic speech tokens (bypassing TTS), then uses those synthetic tokens to speech-instruction-tune LLaMA 3.2, yielding speech-understanding LLMs for low-resource languages like Vietnamese.

title: AI-Researcher: Autonomous Scientific Innovation
summary: A multi-agent LLM system (AI-Researcher) that autonomously orchestrates the full research pipeline — literature review, idea generation, algorithm implementation, validation, and manuscript writing — evaluated on a new benchmark (Scientist-Bench) of 22 papers with guided and open-ended tasks.

title: Multi-Agent Collaboration via Evolving Orchestration
summary: Proposes 'Puppeteer': a centralized, RL-trained (REINFORCE) orchestrator policy that dynamically selects and sequences LLM-based agents ('puppets') each step based on evolving task state, with a reward balancing solution quality and computational cost, yielding compact, cyclic emergent collaboration topologies (Sections 2.1-2.2, 3).

title: Paper2Poster: Towards Multimodal Poster Automation from Scientific Papers
summary: Introduces Paper2Poster, the first benchmark and metric suite for scientific poster generation (Visual Similarity, Figure Relevance, PPL, VLM-as-Judge, PaperQuiz), and PosterAgent, a training-free multi-agent pipeline (Parser, Planner, Painter-Commenter) that converts papers into editable .pptx posters using prompted LLMs/VLMs (Sec. 1, 4).

title: AReaL: A Large-Scale Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning System for Language Reasoning
summary: A fully asynchronous RL training system for large reasoning models that decouples generation from training, uses staleness-aware data control and a decoupled PPO objective, achieving up to 2.77x speedup over synchronous systems with matched or improved accuracy (paper Sections 1, 5, 7).

title: Reasoning Gym: Reasoning Environments for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: A library of 100+ procedurally generated, algorithmically verifiable reasoning task environments (with parametric difficulty control) for RLVR training and evaluation of LLMs, plus experiments showing intra-domain, cross-domain, external-benchmark, and curriculum transfer (Section 2, Section 8).

title: ACE-Step: A Step Towards Music Generation Foundation Model
summary: An open-source text-to-music foundation model combining a mel-spectrogram Deep Compression AutoEncoder, a linear-attention Diffusion Transformer trained with flow matching, and REPA-style semantic alignment to MERT/mHuBERT, enabling fast multi-minute song generation with editing controls (paraphrase of Sections 1, 3).

title: OWSM v4: Improving Open Whisper-Style Speech Models via Data Scaling and Cleaning
summary: The paper (Section 1) builds a scalable data-cleaning pipeline (CTC resegmentation, LID filtering, CTC-score filtering) over YODAS, producing 166k hours of speech in 75 languages, and trains new OWSM v4 AED and CTC speech models (Section 2.2) that outperform prior OWSM versions on multilingual ASR, LID, and ST benchmarks.

title: AssetOpsBench: Benchmarking AI Agents for Task Automation in Industrial Asset Operations and Maintenance
summary: A benchmark ecosystem (per Section 1/4) for evaluating LLM-based multi-agent systems on industrial asset operations: 141 expert-curated scenarios, four domain agents (IoT, FMSR, TSFM, WO), a simulated CouchDB-backed environment, LLM-as-judge plus reference-based scoring, and comparison of Agent-As-Tool vs Plan-Execute orchestration. It is an evaluation framework, not a trainable model.

title: Pre^3: Enabling Deterministic Pushdown Automata for Faster Structured LLM Generation
summary: Pre3 is an inference-time constrained-decoding system that converts LR(1) grammars into deterministic pushdown automata (DPDA). Prefix-conditioned edges (accepted symbol + stack-matching condition + stack operation) make every transition deterministic, so token masks are fully precomputed and stack checks are verified in parallel, eliminating runtime backtracking and persistent-stack exploration. Integrated into LightLLM, the paper reports up to

title: GlobalBuildingAtlas: An Open Global and Complete Dataset of Building Polygons, Heights and LoD1 3D Models
summary: The paper introduces GlobalBuildingAtlas (GBA), an open global dataset of 2.75 billion building polygons (GBA.Polygon), 3 m-resolution building height maps (GBA.Height), and the first complete global LoD1 3D building model (GBA.LoD1, 2.68 billion instances), produced by ML pipelines (UPerNet/ConvNeXt-Tiny segmentation for polygons, HTC-DC Net with EfficientNet-B5 + ViT encoder for monocular height) applied to PlanetScope optical imagery, plus a q

title: OpenThoughts: Data Recipes for Reasoning Models
summary: The paper systematically ablates a data-curation pipeline (question sourcing, mixing, filtering, deduplication, multi-answer teacher sampling, answer filtering, teacher choice) across 1,000+ experiments to build OpenThoughts3-1.2M, an open SFT reasoning dataset, and trains OpenThinker3-7B (fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct) that matches or beats DeepSeek-R1-Distill models on math/code/science benchmarks.

title: ComfyUI-Copilot: An Intelligent Assistant for Automated Workflow Development
summary: An LLM-powered multi-agent plugin for ComfyUI that provides node/model recommendation, one-click workflow generation, and question answering, supported by curated knowledge bases (7K nodes, 62K models, 9K workflows) and a retrieval-plus-reranking pipeline (per Sections 3.1-3.2).

title: Qwen3 Embedding: Advancing Text Embedding and Reranking Through Foundation Models
summary: A family of instruction-aware text embedding and point-wise reranking models built on Qwen3 LLM backbones (0.6B/4B/8B), trained with a multi-stage pipeline (synthetic-data weak supervision, supervised fine-tuning, slerp model merging) achieving state-of-the-art MTEB results.

title: MonkeyOCR: Document Parsing with a Structure-Recognition-Relation Triplet Paradigm
summary: Proposes the Structure-Recognition-Relation (SRR) triplet paradigm that decomposes document parsing into structure detection (DETR-based), block-level content recognition with an LMM, and block-level category-aware reading-order prediction, plus the MonkeyDoc dataset (4.5M bilingual instances) and contiguous parameter degradation (CPD) to prune middle LLM layers (3B down to 0.6B-1.2B).

title: PartCrafter: Structured 3D Mesh Generation via Compositional Latent Diffusion Transformers
summary: A compositional latent diffusion transformer that jointly denoises multiple part-specific latent token sets (with part identity embeddings and local-global attention) to generate part-decomposable 3D meshes from a single RGB image, without segmentation, building on a pretrained 3D mesh DiT (TripoSG).

title: Memory OS of AI Agent
summary: MemoryOS is a memory-management framework for LLM agents (paper fact): a three-tier store (STM dialogue pages, MTM segmented pages, LPM personas) with FIFO dialogue-chain updates, heat-based segment eviction, two-stage retrieval, and prompt-integrated response generation. It is a system/orchestration contribution, not a trainable neural architecture.

title: SpatialLM: Training Large Language Models for Structured Indoor Modeling
summary: Fine-tunes open-source LLMs (e.g., Qwen2.5-0.5B) in an Encoder-MLP-LLM design, with a Sonata/PTv3 point cloud encoder and two-layer MLP projector, to autoregressively emit Python-style scripts describing walls, doors, windows, and oriented object boxes; enabled by a new 12,328-scene synthetic dataset and single-stage full fine-tuning.

title: MiniCPM4: Ultra-Efficient LLMs on End Devices
summary: MiniCPM4 is an efficient end-device LLM family (0.5B/8B) built on InfLLM v2 trainable sparse attention, UltraClean/UltraChat v2 data pipelines, ModelTunnel v2 hyperparameter search, chunk-wise rollout RL, BitCPM4 ternary QAT, and the CPM.cu/ArkInfer inference systems (Sections 1-4).

title: τ²-Bench: Evaluating Conversational Agents in a Dual-Control Environment
summary: The paper introduces τ²-Bench, a benchmark extending τ-Bench with a dual-control telecom domain formalized as a Dec-POMDP, where both an AI agent and a simulated user act via tools on a shared environment; it adds a programmatic compositional task generator, an environment-constrained user simulator, and ablations (Default, No-User, Oracle Plan) separating reasoning failures from communication/coordination failures.

title: Self Forcing: Bridging the Train-Test Gap in Autoregressive Video Diffusion
summary: A post-training paradigm for autoregressive video diffusion that performs autoregressive self-rollout with KV caching during training, supervising whole generated videos with distribution-matching losses (DMD/SiD/GAN) plus gradient truncation and a rolling KV cache for long-video extrapolation.

title: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning
summary: Scales a joint-embedding-predictive architecture (JEPA) to 1B-parameter ViT encoders pretrained on 1M+ hours of internet video via masked feature prediction, then post-trains an action-conditioned latent world model (V-JEPA 2-AC) on ~62 hours of robot data enabling zero-shot robot manipulation via model-predictive control, plus state-of-the-art video QA and action anticipation results.

title: MiniMax-M1: Scaling Test-Time Compute Efficiently with Lightning Attention
summary: A 456B-parameter hybrid MoE reasoning model (45.9B activated, 32 experts) combining lightning (linear) attention blocks with periodic softmax-attention blocks, trained with a novel RL algorithm (CISPO) that clips importance-sampling weights instead of token updates, enabling efficient test-time compute scaling to 1M-token context and 80K-token generation.

title: Arctic Long Sequence Training: Scalable And Efficient Training For Multi-Million Token Sequences
summary: ALST (per Section 1/3 of the paper) combines Ulysses sequence parallelism for Hugging Face models, sequence tiling of logits/loss and MLP compute, and PyTorch memory optimizations (activation checkpoint offload to CPU, expandable segments) to enable multi-million-token training of LLMs like Llama-8B on H100 clusters.

title: From Bytes to Ideas: Language Modeling with Autoregressive U-Nets
summary: AU-Net is a byte-level autoregressive U-Net language model that learns its own tokenization: it pools raw bytes into words and multi-word chunks via user-defined splitting functions, contracts the sequence through stages of increasing width, then expands back with multi-linear upsampling and skip connections, matching BPE baselines under equal compute (paraphrased from Sections 1-3).

title: FLUX.1 Kontext: Flow Matching for In-Context Image Generation and Editing in Latent Space
summary: A rectified-flow transformer (per the paper, Section 2/3) that unifies text-to-image generation and instruction-driven image editing by concatenating latent context-image tokens with target image tokens in the visual stream, using 3D RoPE with a time-offset for context tokens, trained with a velocity-prediction flow-matching objective, plus KontextBench (1026 image-prompt pairs, five task categories).

title: Arch-Router: Aligning LLM Routing with Human Preferences
summary: A preference-aligned LLM routing framework: a compact 1.5B generative model (Arch-Router, SFT from Qwen2.5-1.5B) that reads a user query plus natural-language route policies and generates the best-matching policy identifier, decoupling route selection from model assignment so models can be swapped without retraining.

title: FedFitTech: A Baseline in Federated Learning for Fitness Tracking
summary: A Flower-based federated learning baseline for fitness activity recognition using the TinyHAR model on the WEAR dataset, plus a case study showing client-side early stopping (validation F1 sliding-window stability) cuts communication ~13% with ~1% mean F1 drop (Section 1, Section 3, Section 4).

title: YOLOv13: Real-Time Object Detection with Hypergraph-Enhanced Adaptive Visual Perception
summary: A real-time object detector (paraphrased from Sec. III) that adds HyperACE, an adaptive hypergraph module learning continuous vertex participation in hyperedges to capture global high-order correlations across multi-scale features; a FullPAD paradigm distributing correlation-enhanced features to backbone-neck, in-neck, and neck-head points; and depthwise-separable DS-series blocks (DSConv, DS-Bottleneck, DS-C3k, DS-C3k2) reducing parameters/FLOPs

title: RoboTwin 2.0: A Scalable Data Generator and Benchmark with Strong Domain Randomization for Robust Bimanual Robotic Manipulation
summary: A scalable simulation framework for bimanual manipulation that combines MLLM-based expert code generation with simulation-in-the-loop feedback, five-axis domain randomization (clutter, lighting, background, tabletop height, language), embodiment-aware grasp adaptation, a 731-object asset library (RoboTwin-OD), 50 dual-arm tasks across five embodiments, and 100k+ pre-collected trajectories for training robust manipulation policies (per Abstract an

title: Matrix-Game: Interactive World Foundation Model
summary: A 17B-parameter diffusion-transformer world model for Minecraft that generates action-controllable video from a reference image, trained in two stages (unlabeled pretraining then action-labeled training) on the Matrix-Game-MC dataset, plus the GameWorld Score evaluation benchmark.

title: OmniGen2: Exploration to Advanced Multimodal Generation
summary: OmniGen2 couples a frozen Qwen2.5-VL-3B autoregressive VLM with a randomly initialized diffusion transformer (Lumina-Image 2.0 style) conditioned on variable-length VLM hidden states, uses Omni-RoPE for multi-image positional encoding, and applies a three-stage Flow-GRPO curriculum (Edit -> GenEval-T2I -> In-Context) for instruction alignment, evaluated on T2I, editing, and the new OmniContext benchmark.

title: ClearerVoice-Studio: Bridging Advanced Speech Processing Research and Practical Deployment
summary: An open-source speech processing toolkit (Section 2) unifying speech enhancement (SE), speech separation (SS), super-resolution (SR), and audio-visual/multimodal target speaker extraction (AVSE), built on FRCRN (Section 2.2.1) and MossFormer2 (Section 2.2.2) architectures, with pre-trained models, training scripts, the SpeechScore evaluation toolkit (Section 2.1.3), and benchmarks (Section 3.2).

title: PDFMathTranslate: Scientific Document Translation Preserving Layouts
summary: An open-source systems pipeline (paper, Section 1) that translates scientific PDFs while preserving layouts, combining a YOLOv10-based layout detector (DocLayout-YOLO-DocStructBench-onnx), a pluggable translation middleware (23+ services, 194 languages), and a streaming in-memory re-rendering workflow; assessed by feature/speed comparison, not by ML training.

title: EvoAgentX: An Automated Framework for Evolving Agentic Workflows
summary: An open-source platform (per Sections 1 and 3) that automates generation, execution, evaluation, and evolutionary optimization of multi-agent LLM workflows, integrating TextGrad, AFlow, and MIPRO optimizers across five layers (basic components, agent, workflow, evolving, evaluation).

title: MemOS: A Memory OS for AI System
summary: MemOS is a system-level framework that treats LLM memory (plaintext, activation/KV, and parameter memory) as a schedulable, governable resource, using MemCube units with metadata, plus modules for scheduling, lifecycle, storage, and governance (paper Sections 4-5).

title: Easy Dataset: A Unified and Extensible Framework for Synthesizing LLM Fine-Tuning Data from Unstructured Documents
summary: An end-to-end GUI framework that parses unstructured documents into text chunks and synthesizes diverse persona-driven QA pairs for LLM fine-tuning, with human-in-the-loop refinement; fine-tuning Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on synthesized financial QA improves domain scores while preserving general benchmarks.

title: AXLearn: Modular Large Model Training on Heterogeneous Infrastructure
summary: A production JAX/XLA-based training system (per Sections 1-4) whose contribution is a modular, strictly-encapsulated, hardware-agnostic framework for large-model training with hierarchical configs, config-based parallelism, and runtime fault tolerance - not a new model architecture.

title: Is Diversity All You Need for Scalable Robotic Manipulation?
summary: Empirical study of data diversity in robotic manipulation showing task/scene diversity helps with power-law scaling, multi-embodiment pre-training is non-essential for cross-embodiment transfer, and expert action-rate multimodality is confounding; proposes an Action Rate Model (ARM, SigLIP + MLP head) for distribution debiasing, yielding GO-1-Pro with ~15% gains (paper Sections I, V).

title: A Systematic Analysis of Hybrid Linear Attention
summary: Systematic benchmark of six linear-attention variants (three generations) standalone and hybridized with full attention at five linear:full ratios (72 models, 340M/1.3B), showing standalone scores do not predict hybrid quality, recall (not LM loss) drives optimal ratio, and selective gating, hierarchical recurrence, and controlled forgetting are key; recommends HGRN-2 or GatedDeltaNet at 3:1–6:1.

title: MIRIX: Multi-Agent Memory System for LLM-Based Agents
summary: A modular multi-agent memory system for LLM agents with six specialized memory types (Core, Episodic, Semantic, Procedural, Resource, Knowledge Vault), a Meta Memory Manager for routing, Memory Managers for updates, an Active Retrieval mechanism, and evaluation on ScreenshotVQA and LOCOMO.

title: TinyTroupe: An LLM-powered Multiagent Persona Simulation Toolkit
summary: A Python toolkit for LLM-driven multiagent persona simulation: fine-grained persona specifications, population sampling factories, environments, validators, propositions, steering (stories/interventions), enrichment/extraction, and action-correction, evaluated against real human behavior (paraphrased from Sections 1-4).

title: π³: Scalable Permutation-Equivariant Visual Geometry Learning
summary: A feed-forward multi-view 3D reconstruction network (π³) that removes the fixed reference-view inductive bias: it is fully permutation-equivariant, predicting affine-invariant camera poses, scale-invariant local point maps, and confidence maps per view (Sections 1, 3.1–3.3).

title: WebShaper: Agentically Data Synthesizing via Information-Seeking Formalization
summary: Proposes a set-theoretic formalization of information-seeking tasks via Knowledge Projections (KP), an agentic Expander with layer-wise expansion to synthesize consistent QA training data, and SFT+GRPO training of IS agents achieving SOTA on GAIA and WebWalkerQA (Sections 2-4).

title: TorchAO: PyTorch-Native Training-to-Serving Model Optimization
summary: A PyTorch-native optimization framework (per paper) providing quantization (FP8 training, QAT, PTQ) and sparsity via a tensor-subclass abstraction, integrated across pre-training, fine-tuning, and serving backends.

title: Step-Audio 2 Technical Report
summary: An end-to-end large audio language model (Step-Audio 2) that interleaves discrete text and audio tokens for speech conversation, using a frozen latent audio encoder, an adaptor, an LLM decoder, a flow-matching detokenizer, tool calling (web/audio search), and multi-stage pre-training, SFT, and reinforcement learning (PPO/GRPO).

title: GLiNER2: An Efficient Multi-Task Information Extraction System with Schema-Driven Interface
summary: GLiNER2 extends the GLiNER encoder-based zero-shot NER paradigm into a single CPU-efficient 205M-parameter model that unifies named entity recognition, text classification, and hierarchical structured extraction via learned special-token prompt templates ([P], [E], [C], [L], [SEP]) and a declarative schema interface, enabling multi-task composition in one forward pass.

title: HunyuanWorld 1.0: Generating Immersive, Explorable, and Interactive 3D Worlds from Words or Pixels
summary: A staged framework (per Section 2) that generates 360-degree panoramic world proxies from text or images via a diffusion transformer (Panorama-DiT), decomposes scenes into semantic layers (sky, background, foreground objects) via agentic VLM-driven layering, reconstructs a layered 3D mesh world via layer-aligned depth estimation and sheet warping, and extends exploration with a world-consistent video diffusion model (Voyager) using point-cloud wo

title: MetaCLIP 2: A Worldwide Scaling Recipe
summary: A recipe for training CLIP from scratch on worldwide (English + non-English) web-scale image-text pairs: per-language metadata, language-aware curation with per-language head/tail thresholds, and scaled seen pairs (2.3x batch) with sufficient model capacity (ViT-H/14) to break the curse of multilinguality.

title: Towards a Periodic Table of Computer System Design Principles
summary: The paper (Sections 1-3) distills 40+ recurring computer-system design principles from 100+ influential papers into a 'periodic table' organized into eight thematic groups (Structure, Efficiency, Semantics, Distribution, Planning, Operability, Reliability, Security), offering a shared vocabulary rather than a new model or algorithm. It contains no neural architecture, no training procedure, and no empirical model results.

title: ScreenCoder: Advancing Visual-to-Code Generation for Front-End Automation via Modular Multimodal Agents
summary: A modular multi-agent pipeline (grounding, planning, generation) for screenshot-to-HTML/CSS generation, plus a data engine producing Screen-10K and dual-stage SFT+GRPO post-training of Qwen2.5-VL, evaluated on new ScreenBench.

title: Trae Agent: An LLM-based Agent for Software Engineering with Test-time Scaling
summary: Trae Agent is an agent-based ensemble reasoning framework for repository-level software issue resolution: a coder agent generates diverse candidate patches, hierarchical pruning (deduplication + regression testing) shrinks the ensemble, and a selector agent with majority voting picks the final patch, improving Pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified.

title: VeOmni: Scaling Any Modality Model Training with Model-Centric Distributed Recipe Zoo
summary: A model-centric distributed training framework (per Section 3) that decouples model definition from parallel logic, enabling composable FSDP/HSDP, sequence parallelism (DeepSpeed-Ulysses), and expert parallelism for omni-modal LLMs with encoder-foundation-decoder composition (Section 3.1).

title: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
summary: A two-stage framework for financial K-line (OHLCVA) data: a Transformer-based tokenizer with Binary Spherical Quantization produces hierarchical coarse/fine discrete tokens, and a decoder-only autoregressive Transformer is pre-trained to predict coarse then fine subtokens sequentially (paper Sections 2-3).

title: Agent Lightning: Train ANY AI Agents with Reinforcement Learning
summary: A framework (per the paper) that decouples RL training of LLMs from agent execution via an MDP-based unified data interface, a hierarchical RL algorithm (LightningRL) with credit assignment, and a Training-Agent Disaggregation architecture (Lightning Server/Client) with OpenTelemetry-based trajectory capture and Automatic Intermediate Rewarding.

title: Multi-module GRPO: Composing Policy Gradients and Prompt Optimization for Language Model Programs
summary: The paper introduces mmGRPO, a GRPO variant for multi-module LM programs that forms groups from module-level invocations (or full trajectories), and shows that combining it with prompt optimization (MIPROv2) via BetterTogether improves accuracy by 11% on average over unadapted models across Banking77, PAPILLON, and HoVer tasks (paraphrased from Sections 1, 3, 5).

title: GLM-4.5: Agentic, Reasoning, and Coding (ARC) Foundation Models
summary: An open-source 355B-parameter (32B activated) Mixture-of-Experts LLM with hybrid thinking/direct-response modes, trained on 23T tokens with multi-stage pre-training, mid-training, and expert-iteration post-training, achieving strong agentic, reasoning, and coding benchmark results; a smaller GLM-4.5-Air (106B/12B) variant is also released.

title: BeyondMimic: From Motion Tracking to Versatile Humanoid Control via Guided Diffusion
summary: A two-stage humanoid control framework: (1) scalable RL motion tracking with a compact, motion-agnostic reward and shared hyperparameters, and (2) a latent state-action diffusion model with classifier guidance enabling zero-shot downstream tasks (joystick, waypoint, obstacle avoidance, inpainting) at inference time.

title: Prompt Orchestration Markup Language
summary: POML is an HTML-like markup language for structuring LLM prompts: semantic intention components (role/task/example), data components (document/table/image), a CSS-like styling system decoupling content from presentation, a templating engine, and IDE/SDK tooling. It is a prompt-engineering framework, not a neural architecture; the paper trains no model.

title: Accelerating GenAI Workloads by Enabling RISC-V Microkernel Support in IREE
summary: The paper (per 'Methodology') adds RISC-V64 support to the IREE MLIR compiler: lowering linalg contraction ops to tensor.pack/linalg.mmt4d/tensor.unpack with VLEN-aware tiling, plus f16xf16->f32 mmt4d microkernels for LLM prefill (GEMM) and decode (GEMV), benchmarked on Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct. It is a compiler/runtime acceleration work, not a new model architecture.

title: Mobile-Agent-v3: Foundamental Agents for GUI Automation
summary: Introduces GUI-Owl, a Qwen2.5-VL-based end-to-end multimodal GUI agent post-trained on self-evolving trajectory data with a scalable online RL framework (TRPO), and Mobile-Agent-v3, a four-role multi-agent framework (Manager, Worker, Reflector, Notetaker) that raises GUI automation success rates on AndroidWorld and OSWorld-Verified.

title: Efficient Mixed-Precision Large Language Model Inference with TurboMind
summary: TurboMind, an LMDeploy inference engine with hardware-aware mixed-precision GEMM and attention pipelines (weight packing, adaptive head alignment, instruction-level parallelism, KV memory loading pipeline) delivering large latency/throughput gains over vLLM+MARLIN, TensorRT-LLM, and QServe on GPUs.

title: Memento: Fine-tuning LLM Agents without Fine-tuning LLMs
summary: A memory-based learning paradigm (M-MDP) where an LLM agent adapts continually via case-based reasoning over an episodic case bank, training only a small case-selection Q-function (binary CE loss) while the LLMs stay frozen.

title: AgentScope 1.0: A Developer-Centric Framework for Building Agentic Applications
summary: A developer-oriented framework (paper facts) for LLM-based agentic applications built on the ReAct paradigm, with modular message/model/memory/tool components, agent-level infrastructure (steering, parallel tool calls, state persistence), built-in agents, and evaluation/studio/runtime toolkits. It is a systems paper, not a trainable neural architecture.

title: VibeVoice Technical Report
summary: A next-token-diffusion TTS system that uses a pre-trained LLM (Qwen2.5) over concatenated voice/text prompts with role identifiers, plus ultra-low-frame-rate (7.5 Hz) acoustic (σ-VAE) and semantic speech tokenizers and a token-level diffusion head, to synthesize up to 90 minutes of multi-speaker conversational speech (per paper Sections 1-2).

title: AHELM: A Holistic Evaluation of Audio-Language Models
summary: AHELM is a holistic benchmark for audio-language models (ALMs) that aggregates 14 existing datasets plus two new synthetic ones (PARADE for bias, CoRe-Bench for conversational audio reasoning) to evaluate 10 aspects (perception, knowledge, reasoning, emotion, bias, fairness, multilinguality, robustness, toxicity, safety) with standardized zero-shot prompts, inference parameters, and automated metrics, applied to 14 ALMs and 3 ASR+LM baseline syst

title: MobiAgent: A Systematic Framework for Customizable Mobile Agents
summary: A full-stack mobile GUI agent system: MobiMind multi-role models (Planner/Decider/Grounder post-trained from Qwen2.5-VL via SFT + two-stage curriculum GRPO), AgentRR record-replay acceleration with ActTree and latent memory models, and the MobiFlow DAG-based benchmark.

title: LLaVA-Critic-R1: Your Critic Model is Secretly a Strong Policy Model
summary: The paper shows that reorganizing preference-labeled critic data into a verifiable RL task (GRPO with a preference + format reward) and training a base VLM directly on it yields a single model (LLaVA-Critic-R1) that is simultaneously a strong critic and a competitive policy model, with +5.7% average policy gain over Qwen-2.5-VL-7B and +13.8% from test-time self-critic scaling.

title: Flavors of Moonshine: Tiny Specialized ASR Models for Edge Devices
summary: Per the paper, a suite of 27M-parameter monolingual Moonshine Tiny ASR models for six underrepresented languages, trained on a mix of human-labeled, pseudo-labeled, and synthetic data, achieving on average 48% lower WER/CER than Whisper Tiny and beating the 9x larger Whisper Small.

title: UI-TARS-2 Technical Report: Advancing GUI Agent with Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
summary: A native GUI-centered agent model (532M vision encoder + 230B-total/23B-active MoE LLM) trained via a data flywheel (CT, SFT, RFT, multi-turn PPO RL) in a unified sandbox spanning GUI, terminal, and game environments, with parameter interpolation to merge domain-specialized agents.

title: Paper2Agent: Reimagining Research Papers As Interactive and Reliable AI Agents
summary: A multi-agent framework (built on Claude Code) that converts research papers and their codebases into Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with validated tools, resources, and prompts, enabling natural-language paper agents that reproduce results and support autonomous scientific discovery (per Sections 1-2 and Extended Methods).

title: Continuous Audio Language Models
summary: The paper proposes CALM: autoregressive generation of continuous VAE latents for audio, using a causal Transformer backbone with training-time noise injection, a short-context Transformer, and a small consistency-model MLP head that samples the next latent in one step, replacing discrete RVQ token prediction and diffusion heads (Sections 1, 4.2).

title: RLFactory: A Plug-and-Play Reinforcement Learning Post-Training Framework for LLM Multi-Turn Tool-Use
summary: A plug-and-Play RL post-training framework for LLM multi-turn tool use, featuring asyncio-based asynchronous tool calls, a decoupled tool-environment/training architecture, diverse reward computation (rule-based, model-judge, tool verification), and observation tokens that reconstruct the MDP state space (per paper Sections 1-2).

title: One Model for All Tasks: Leveraging Efficient World Models in Multi-Task Planning
summary: Proposes ScaleZero, a UniZero-based multitask world model with a sparse MoE backbone (1 shared + 8 routed experts, top-1 gating) to mitigate gradient conflicts and plasticity collapse, plus Dynamic Parameter Scaling (DPS), a staged LoRA-adapter expansion strategy that reduces environment interactions by ~28.5% on DMC.

title: Sharing is Caring: Efficient LM Post-Training with Collective RL Experience Sharing
summary: SAPO, a fully decentralized asynchronous RL post-training algorithm where heterogeneous nodes train their own policies and share decoded rollouts; balanced sharing (4 local / 4 external) improved cumulative reward up to 94% over no-sharing baselines on ReasoningGYM tasks.

title: Streaming Sequence-to-Sequence Learning with Delayed Streams Modeling
summary: Delayed Streams Modeling (DSM): a decoder-only Transformer that models pre-aligned, time-delayed token streams (e.g., Mimi audio codec tokens and text tokens) for streaming ASR and TTS, with delay conditioning, action/lookahead streams, and speaker conditioning via CFG.

title: VLA-Adapter: An Effective Paradigm for Tiny-Scale Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: Proposes a lightweight bridging paradigm (Bridge Attention with learnable tanh-gated injection of Raw and ActionQuery latents) that lets a 0.5B VLM backbone, without robotic pre-training, feed a 97M-parameter L1-based Policy producing action chunks, achieving SOTA-level LIBERO/CALVIN results at low cost (paper Sections 3-4).

title: SimpleVLA-RL: Scaling VLA Training via Reinforcement Learning
summary: An online RL framework (GRPO-based, built on veRL) that fine-tunes VLA models like OpenVLA-OFT with binary outcome rewards, dynamic sampling, clip-higher, and higher rollout temperature, improving success rates on LIBERO/RoboTwin and enabling sim-to-real transfer (paraphrased from Sections 1, 3, 4).

title: QuantAgent: Price-Driven Multi-Agent LLMs for High-Frequency Trading
summary: QuantHarness is a multi-agent LLM framework for high-frequency trading that operates solely on OHLC price data, decomposing decisions into Indicator, Pattern, Trend, and Risk agents whose structured reports a DecisionAgent fuses into LONG/SHORT calls with a risk-reward ratio (paper facts, Sections 3-4).

title: RSL-RL: A Learning Library for Robotics Research
summary: A compact, GPU-only open-source RL library for robotics centered on PPO and DAgger-style behavior-cloning distillation, with symmetry augmentation and RND-based curiosity, structured as Runners/Algorithms/Networks (paper Sections 1-3).

title: Fun-ASR Technical Report
summary: Fun-ASR is a large-scale LLM-based ASR system (7.7B and 0.8B variants) combining a transformer audio encoder, audio adaptor, CTC decoder, and LLM decoder, trained via Best-RQ self-supervised pre-training, multi-stage SFT, contextual SFT, and GRPO-based RL (FunRL), with production optimizations for streaming, noise robustness, code-switching, and RAG-based hotword customization.

title: Single-stream Policy Optimization
summary: SPO replaces GRPO's per-group baselines with a persistent KL-adaptive Bayesian value tracker, global batch advantage normalization, and prioritized prompt sampling, enabling group-free, higher-throughput RLVR training of LLM reasoners (paper claims +3.4 pp avg maj@32 over GRPO on Qwen3-8B).

title: Scaling Agents via Continual Pre-training
summary: Proposes Agentic Continual Pre-training (Agentic CPT) as an intermediate stage between pre-training and post-training, using offline-synthesized agentic data (FAS and HAS) and a two-stage 32K/128K-context training strategy to build AgentFounder-30B, a deep research agent foundation model.

title: Cybersecurity AI: Humanoid Robots as Attack Vectors
summary: A security assessment of the Unitree G1 humanoid robot showing BLE command-injection compromise, partially broken FMX encryption (Blowfish-ECB + LCG), persistent telemetry exfiltration, and a Cybersecurity AI (CAI) agent running on-device for reconnaissance and exploitation preparation. This is a security-analysis paper, not a machine-learning modeling paper.

title: On the Use of Agentic Coding Manifests: An Empirical Study of Claude Code
summary: An empirical software-engineering study (not a machine learning paper) analyzing 253 Claude.md agentic coding manifest files from 242 repositories, finding shallow hierarchical structure (one H1, ~5 H2, ~9 H3) and dominant content categories: Build and Run (77.1%), Implementation Details (71.9%), and Architecture (64.8%).

title: Qwen3-Omni Technical Report
summary: A Thinker–Talker MoE multimodal model (text/image/audio/video in; text and streaming speech out) trained jointly across modalities without degrading unimodal performance, with a new AuT audio encoder, multi-codebook Talker with MTP, and a causal ConvNet Code2Wav achieving 234 ms first-packet latency.

title: MiniCPM-V 4.5: Cooking Efficient MLLMs via Architecture, Data, and Training Recipe
summary: An 8B multimodal LLM combining a unified 3D-Resampler for compact image/video token encoding, a corruption-based unified document-knowledge/OCR learning paradigm, and hybrid short/long reasoning RL post-training (per Sections 1-2 of the paper).

title: Lyra: Generative 3D Scene Reconstruction via Video Diffusion Model Self-Distillation
summary: A self-distillation framework (per paper Sec. 3) in which a frozen camera-controlled video diffusion model (GEN3C) acts as a teacher whose RGB-decoded multi-view video latents supervise a student 3D Gaussian Splatting decoder operating in the video latent space, enabling feed-forward static 3D and dynamic 4D scene generation from a single image or video without real multi-view training data.

title: Real-Time Object Detection Meets DINOv3
summary: DEIMv2 extends the DEIM real-time DETR-style detector with DINOv3-pretrained/distilled ViT backbones plus a parameter-free Spatial Tuning Adapter (STA) that converts single-scale ViT features into multi-scale features, a simplified decoder (SwiGLU FFN, RMSNorm, shared query position embeddings), an upgraded Dense O2O with Copy-Blend augmentation, and pruned HGNetv2 backbones for ultra-light variants, achieving SOTA COCO results across eight model

title: Democratizing AI scientists using ToolUniverse
summary: The paper presents ToolUniverse, an open platform that standardizes how conversational LLM-based AI scientists discover, call, compose, discover, and optimize over 2,700 scientific tools and 130 research skills via a uniform AI-tool interaction standard (paper facts, Introduction and Supplementary Notes S1-S3). It is a systems/platform paper, not a neural architecture paper.

title: Tequila: Trapping-free Ternary Quantization for Large Language Models
summary: Tequila identifies 'deadzone trapping' in ternary weight quantization (weights quantized to 0 receive noisy STE gradients and never escape) and repurposes deadzone weights as input-agnostic dynamic biases C(W)=Σ_{i∈D} λw_i, added to the ternary output Y = XQ(W)α + C(W), giving direct differentiable gradients with nearly zero inference overhead (Section 3.2, Extracted text block 114).

title: HunyuanImage 3.0 Technical Report
summary: An open-source native multimodal model unifying text understanding and image generation in one autoregressive MoE LLM (80B total / 13B active), using Transfusion-style diffusion on VAE latents, generalized causal attention, 2D RoPE, Chain-of-Thought training, and multi-stage post-training.

title: SANA-Video: Efficient Video Generation with Block Linear Diffusion Transformer
summary: A small (2B) latent video diffusion model built on a Linear DiT (ReLU-kernel linear attention with RoPE applied after ReLU), a constant-memory block-linear-attention KV cache enabling block-autoregressive minute-long video generation, a deep-compression video VAE (DCAE-V), and multi-stage training continued from a text-to-image model.

title: Pretraining Large Language Models with NVFP4
summary: NVIDIA demonstrates stable 4-bit (NVFP4) pretraining of LLMs by combining mixed-precision layer selection, Random Hadamard transforms on weight-gradient GEMMs, 2D block scaling for weights, and stochastic rounding of gradients; a 12B hybrid Mamba-Transformer trained on 10T tokens matches an FP8 baseline in loss and downstream accuracy.

title: DeepScientist: Advancing Frontier-Pushing Scientific Findings Progressively
summary: DeepScientist is an LLM-based autonomous scientific-discovery agent that frames discovery as Bayesian Optimization over a Findings Memory, using a three-stage 'hypothesize, verify, analyze' loop with UCB-based selection to progressively surpass human SOTA on three AI tasks (per Section 3 of the paper).

title: JoyAgent-JDGenie: Technical Report on the GAIA
summary: A system-level generalist LLM agent framework combining Plan-Execute and ReAct multi-agent ensembles with critic voting, hierarchical memory (working/semantic/procedural), and a curated tool suite (search, code execution, multimodal parsing), evaluated on GAIA (75.2 Pass@1 validation, 67.1 test).

title: Code2Video: A Code-centric Paradigm for Educational Video Generation
summary: A tri-agent framework (Planner, Coder, Critic) that generates educational videos by producing and refining executable Manim Python code, plus the MMMC benchmark and TeachQuiz knowledge-transfer metric (paraphrased from Abstract and Section 4).

title: Ovi: Twin Backbone Cross-Modal Fusion for Audio-Video Generation
