summary: OVI (per Section 4.1) unifies audio-video generation as a single latent diffusion process using two architecturally identical DiT towers (video initialized from Wan2.2 5B, audio trained from scratch) fused via blockwise bidirectional cross-attention, with scaled-RoPE temporal alignment and a single frozen T5 encoder conditioning both branches from a combined prompt.

title: Enhancing OCR for Sino-Vietnamese Language Processing via Fine-tuned PaddleOCRv5
summary: Fine-tunes the PP-OCRv5 recognition module (SVTR-HGNet student distilled from a GTC-NRTR teacher) on a curated subset of a Chinese Document Text Recognition dataset to improve Han-Nom character recognition on degraded historical scans, raising exact accuracy from 37.5% to 50.0% and improving downstream Han-Vietnamese Bertalign sentence alignment.

title: Less is More: Recursive Reasoning with Tiny Networks
summary: Proposes Tiny Recursive Model (TRM), a simplified recursive-reasoning network (single 2-layer network, two carried features y and z, full backprop through one recursion process, deep supervision, simplified halting, EMA) that outperforms HRM and many LLMs on Sudoku-Extreme, Maze-Hard, and ARC-AGI with ~7M parameters (paper Sections 4-5).

title: Paper2Video: Automatic Video Generation from Scientific Papers
summary: Introduces Paper2Video, a 101-paper benchmark with author-made presentation videos and four metrics (Meta Similarity, PresentArena, PresentQuiz, IP Memory), and PaperTalker, a multi-agent pipeline generating academic presentation videos via LaTeX Beamer slide generation with tree-search visual layout choice, subtitle/cursor grounding (UI-TARS + WhisperX), F5-TTS speech, and parallel talking-head rendering (Hallo2/FantasyTalking).

title: In-the-Flow Agentic System Optimization for Effective Planning and Tool Use
summary: AgentFlow: a trainable agentic system with four modules (planner, executor, verifier, generator) coordinated via an evolving memory, plus Flow-GRPO, an on-policy RL algorithm that broadcasts a single trajectory-level outcome reward to every turn and uses group-normalized advantages to convert multi-turn RL into single-turn updates (Section 3, per 'Extracted text block 140' and 'Extracted text block 168').

title: DreamOmni2: Multimodal Instruction-based Editing and Generation
summary: Proposes two new tasks (multimodal instruction-based editing and generation using text plus multiple reference images covering concrete objects and abstract attributes), a three-stage synthetic data pipeline with a feature-mixing attention scheme, an index-encoding/position-encoding-shift scheme for multi-image inputs on a Flux Kontext DIT base, and joint VLM+generation training (paper Sections 1, 3).

title: Stable Video Infinity: Infinite-Length Video Generation with Error Recycling
summary: The paper proposes SVI, which fine-tunes a video Diffusion Transformer (Wan 2.1 I2V 14B) via Error-Recycling Fine-Tuning (ERFT): self-generated errors are injected into clean flow-matching inputs, approximated via one-step bidirectional integration, banked in timestep-indexed replay memory, and resampled so the model learns an error-recycled velocity, enabling infinite-length autoregressive video generation with LoRA-only tuning (per Sections 3-4

title: LMCache: An Efficient KV Cache Layer for Enterprise-Scale LLM Inference
summary: A systems paper (not a model paper): LMCache is an open-source KV-cache storage/transfer layer that offloads LLM KV caches from GPU memory, shares them across queries and inference engines (vLLM, SGLang), with batched chunked I/O, compute-I/O pipelining, a standardized connector API, and controller APIs (lookup, move, pin, compress), yielding up to 15x throughput gains.

title: Diffusion Transformers with Representation Autoencoders
summary: The paper replaces VAEs in diffusion transformers with frozen pretrained representation encoders (e.g., DINOv2) paired with trained ViT decoders (Representation Autoencoders, RAE), and adapts DiT training to these high-dimensional latents via width matching, dimension-dependent noise schedule shift, noise-augmented decoding, and a wide shallow DDT head (DiTDH), achieving state-of-the-art ImageNet FID.

title: RAG-Anything: All-in-One RAG Framework
summary: A unified multimodal RAG framework that decomposes documents into atomic multimodal units, builds dual (cross-modal + text-based) knowledge graphs merged via entity alignment, and retrieves via hybrid structural navigation plus dense semantic matching before VLM-based answer synthesis.

title: Synthesizing Agentic Data for Web Agents with Progressive Difficulty Enhancement Mechanisms
summary: ProgSearch: a two-pronged synthetic QA data pipeline (top-down tree-of-facts and bottom-up rare-entity-anchor hardening) that uses a baseline web agent to progressively raise question difficulty until the agent fails, with aggressive factuality/uniqueness filtering; effectiveness shown via controlled distillation SFT of Qwen models.

title: xLLM Technical Report
summary: A decoupled service-engine LLM inference framework (xLLM-Service for scheduling/KV-cache/fault tolerance; xLLM-Engine for pipeline, graph, memory, and algorithmic inference optimizations) targeting Ascend accelerators, with reported throughput gains over MindIE and vLLM-Ascend.

title: Chronos-2: From Univariate to Universal Forecasting
summary: A 120M-parameter pretrained encoder-only time series transformer that handles univariate, multivariate, and covariate-informed forecasting zero-shot via a group attention mechanism enabling in-context learning, trained largely on synthetic multivariate data (paraphrased from Sections 1, 3, 4).

title: DeepAnalyze: Agentic Large Language Models for Autonomous Data Science
summary: Introduces DeepAnalyze-8B, an agentic LLM for autonomous data science that uses five special action tokens (<Analyze>, <Understand>, <Code>, <Execute>, <Answer>) to autonomously orchestrate data tasks, trained via curriculum-based agentic training (single-ability SFT then multi-ability GRPO RL) with data-grounded trajectory synthesis.

title: DeepSeek-OCR: Contexts Optical Compression
summary: Paper proposes DeepSeek-OCR, a VLM testing whether long text contexts can be optically compressed: a DeepEncoder (SAM window-attention stage + 16x conv token compressor + CLIP global-attention stage) feeds compressed vision tokens to a DeepSeek-3B-MoE decoder that reconstructs text, achieving ~97% OCR precision below 10x compression (Section 1, 3.1-3.3).

title: Pico-Banana-400K: A Large-Scale Dataset for Text-Guided Image Editing
summary: The paper introduces Pico-Banana-400K, a ~400K-example dataset for instruction-based image editing built from real OpenImages photographs, generated with Nano-Banana and quality-filtered by Gemini-2.5-Pro judging, organized by a 35-type edit taxonomy, with single-turn SFT (258K), preference (56K), and multi-turn (72K) subsets plus dual long/short instruction variants. It is a dataset/resource paper, not a model architecture paper.

title: Kimi Linear: An Expressive, Efficient Attention Architecture
summary: Proposes Kimi Delta Attention (KDA), a channel-wise-gated extension of Gated DeltaNet with a specialized DPLR transition, and Kimi Linear, a 3:1 KDA-to-MLA hybrid MoE model (48B total / 3B active) that outperforms full attention with up to 75% KV-cache reduction and ~6x decoding throughput at 1M context (per paper, Sections 1, 4, 5).

title: Alpamayo-R1: Bridging Reasoning and Action Prediction for Generalizable Autonomous Driving in the Long Tail
summary: A vision-language-action driving model (per Sec. 3) that combines a Cosmos-Reason VLM backbone, structured Chain-of-Causation reasoning data (Sec. 4), a flow-matching trajectory decoder (Sec. 3.2.2), and multi-stage SFT + GRPO RL post-training (Sec. 5) to improve long-tail driving performance.

title: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano V2 VL
summary: A 12B vision-language model combining a hybrid Mamba-Transformer LLM (Nemotron Nano V2), a RADIOv2.5 vision encoder, and an MLP connector, trained with a multi-stage SFT recipe (connector warmup, 16K/49K/300K context extension, code-reasoning recovery) plus token-reduction techniques (tiling, pixel shuffle, Efficient Video Sampling) for document, video, and reasoning tasks.

title: RF-DETR: Neural Architecture Search for Real-Time Detection Transformers
summary: The paper introduces RF-DETR, a lightweight specialist detection transformer built on a DINOv2 ViT backbone with windowed/non-windowed attention, a multi-scale projector, and a DETR decoder, trained with weight-sharing neural architecture search over patch size, resolution, decoder layers, queries, and windows to produce accuracy-latency Pareto curves for object detection and instance segmentation (Sections 1, 3).

title: Omnilingual ASR: Open-Source Multilingual Speech Recognition for 1600+ Languages
summary: A family of wav2vec 2.0-based encoder–decoder ASR models (300M–7B) pre-trained on 4.3M hours of unlabeled speech across 1600+ languages, fine-tuned with CTC or an LLM-style Transformer decoder, and extended with a zero-shot in-context mode that transcribes unseen languages from a handful of speech–text examples (per Sections 4–5).

title: Depth Anything 3: Recovering the Visual Space from Any Views
summary: A minimal any-view geometry model (DA3) showing that a single plain pretrained ViT backbone with input-adaptive cross-view attention, trained to predict per-pixel depth plus ray maps (with an optional lightweight camera head), suffices for pose, depth, and reconstruction from arbitrary numbers of images, using teacher-student pseudo-labeling on real data.

title: MiroThinker: Pushing the Performance Boundaries of Open-Source Research Agents via Model, Context, and Interactive Scaling
summary: An open-source ReAct-style research agent (8B/30B/72B, Qwen2.5/Qwen3-based) trained via SFT, DPO, and GRPO RL, showing that scaling agent-environment interaction depth (up to 600 tool calls, 256K context) is a third scaling axis alongside model size and context length.

title: Agent READMEs: An Empirical Study of Context Files for Agentic Coding
summary: First large-scale empirical study of 2,303 agent context files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, copilot-instructions.md) from 1,925 repositories, characterizing their structure, maintenance, and 16-category instruction taxonomy, and showing automatic classification is feasible (micro F1 0.79) while non-functional instructions (Security 14.8%, Performance 14.5%) are rare.

title: Agent-R1: Training Powerful LLM Agents with End-to-End Reinforcement Learning
summary: A modular framework for agentic RL that treats each interaction step (not each token) as the native RL transition, stores step-level trajectories to avoid retokenization drift, and exposes flexible environment-defined context construction, compatible with PPO/GRPO-style optimizers.

title: SAM 3D: 3Dfy Anything in Images
summary: A generative two-stage model (Geometry + Texture & Refinement flow transformers) that predicts per-object 3D shape, texture, and layout from a single image, enabled by a model-in-the-loop data engine and multi-stage synthetic-to-real training (per Sections 2-3).

title: HunyuanVideo 1.5 Technical Report
summary: An 8.3B-parameter open-source video generation model: a unified Diffusion Transformer (DiT) for text-to-video and image-to-video with a causal 3D VAE, Selective and Sliding Tile Attention (SSTA) sparse attention, dual-channel text encoding (Qwen2.5-VL plus Glyph-ByT5), progressive multi-task pre-training and post-training, a Muon optimizer, and a cascaded video super-resolution network for 1080p output.

title: Fara-7B: An Efficient Agentic Model for Computer Use
summary: Introduces FaraGen, a synthetic data engine (task proposal, multi-agent solving, multi-verifier filtering) that produces ~145K verified web trajectories at ~$1 each, used to SFT Fara-7B, a 7B pixel-in/action-out computer-use agent built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, plus the WebTailBench benchmark.

title: GigaWorld-0: World Models as Data Engine to Empower Embodied AI
summary: A unified world-model framework (GigaWorld-0) acting as a data engine for embodied AI: a MoE DiT video foundation model with flow matching plus controllable post-trained variants (appearance/view/mimic transfer), an IDM for action inference, and a 3D pipeline (asset generation, 3DGS reconstruction, differentiable physics identification, action synthesis), trained efficiently with FP8 and sparse attention (GigaTrain).

title: Soft Adaptive Policy Optimization
summary: SAPO (Section 3) replaces hard clipping in group-based RL for LLMs with a temperature-controlled sigmoid soft gate on token importance ratios, plus asymmetric temperatures (τ_neg > τ_pos) so negative-token gradients decay faster, improving training stability and Pass@1 on math reasoning benchmarks.

title: Qwen3-VL Technical Report
summary: A family of vision-language models (dense 2B-32B and MoE 30B-A3B/235B-A22B) built on Qwen3 backbones with a SigLIP-2 vision encoder, introducing interleaved MRoPE, DeepStack multi-level ViT feature injection, text-based video timestamps, and a four-stage pretraining plus three-stage post-training pipeline (paper Sections 1-4).

title: DeepSeekMath-V2: Towards Self-Verifiable Mathematical Reasoning
summary: The paper trains an LLM-based proof verifier with RL against expert rubric scores, adds meta-verification to suppress hallucinated issues, uses the verifier as a reward model for a proof generator with self-verification incentives, and scales verification compute to auto-label hard proofs, yielding gold-level IMO/CMO and 118/120 Putnam 2024 results (Sections 2-3).

title: CuES: A Curiosity-driven and Environment-grounded Synthesis Framework for Agentic RL
summary: The paper formalizes Task Generation for Agentic RL (mapping an environment without predefined tasks to a proxy goal distribution) and proposes CuES, a five-stage pipeline (Requirement Confirmation, Curious Exploration, Task Abstraction, Quality Control, Goal Rewrite) that synthesizes executable, diverse, relevant training tasks from environment interaction, improving downstream RL policy performance on AppWorld, WebShop, and BFCL v3.

title: Learning Sim-to-Real Humanoid Locomotion in 15 Minutes
summary: A minimalist sim-to-real recipe using off-policy RL (FastSAC/FastTD3) with massively parallel simulation, joint-limit-aware action bounds, layer normalization, averaged (non-clipped) double Q-learning, distributional C51 critics, and <10-term rewards, training full-body humanoid locomotion and whole-body tracking policies in ~15 minutes on one RTX 4090.

title: dots.ocr: Multilingual Document Layout Parsing in a Single Vision-Language Model
summary: A single vision-language model (1.2B ViT vision encoder + 1.7B Qwen2.5-based decoder) that jointly performs layout detection, text recognition, and reading-order inference as one autoregressive generation task, powered by a three-stage multilingual data engine, achieving state-of-the-art results on OmniDocBench and the new 126-language XDocParse benchmark.

title: PaperDebugger: A Plugin-Based Multi-Agent System for In-Editor Academic Writing, Review, and Editing
summary: A demo systems paper describing an in-editor (Overleaf) multi-agent academic writing assistant built as a Chrome extension with a Kubernetes/Go backend, gRPC streaming, and an MCP-based tool layer (XtraMCP) for literature retrieval, structured review, scoring, and diff-based patching, plus early usage telemetry. It is an orchestration/UX contribution, not a new neural architecture.

title: SignRoundV2: Closing the Performance Gap in Extremely Low-Bit Post-Training Quantization for LLMs
summary: A post-training quantization framework for LLMs that (1) allocates per-layer bit-widths using a gradient-weighted perturbation sensitivity metric (DeltaLoss) solved via dynamic programming, and (2) stabilizes low-bit tuning with a pre-tuning scale search and loss filtering (per Section 3 of the paper).

title: DeepCode: Open Agentic Coding
summary: DeepCode is an LLM-based multi-agent framework that converts specification documents (e.g., scientific papers) into executable code repositories via four information operations: blueprint distillation, stateful code memory (CodeMem), retrieval-augmented knowledge injection (CodeRAG), and closed-loop verification, achieving state-of-the-art PaperBench replication scores.

title: Remember Me, Refine Me: A Dynamic Procedural Memory Framework for Experience-Driven Agent Evolution
summary: ReMe is an LLM-agent procedural-memory framework (not a neural architecture): it distills structured experiences from agent trajectories, retrieves/adapts them for new tasks, and refines the pool via selective addition and utility-based deletion, showing a memory-scaling effect on BFCL-V3 and AppWorld.

title: AI-Trader: Benchmarking Autonomous Agents in Real-Time Financial Markets
summary: The paper introduces AI-Trader, a live, fully autonomous, data-uncontaminated benchmark that evaluates six LLM agents trading U.S. stocks, A-shares, and cryptocurrencies with minimal-information tool use, finding that general LLM intelligence does not translate into profitable, risk-controlled trading (Sections 1, 3, 4).

title: Fast-FoundationStereo: Real-Time Zero-Shot Stereo Matching
summary: The paper (paper fact) accelerates FoundationStereo, a zero-shot stereo matching model, to real-time via three divide-and-conquer strategies: knowledge distillation of the hybrid DepthAnythingV2 + side-tuning CNN backbone into a single student; blockwise NAS with distillation for the cost filtering module under latency budgets (ILP selection); and structured pruning of the ConvGRU refinement module. It also introduces a pseudo-labeling pipeline p

title: PersonaLive! Expressive Portrait Image Animation for Live Streaming
summary: A three-stage diffusion-based portrait animation framework for real-time streaming: hybrid motion control (implicit facial representations + 3D implicit keypoints), fewer-step appearance distillation, and autoregressive micro-chunk streaming generation with sliding training and a historical keyframe mechanism (per Sections 1, 3, and 'More implementation details').

title: WorldPlay: Towards Long-Term Geometric Consistency for Real-Time Interactive World Modeling
summary: A streaming, action-conditioned video diffusion world model (per Section 3) that combines a dual action representation (discrete keys + continuous camera poses via PRoPE), a Reconstituted Context Memory with temporal reframing of positional encodings, and a memory-aligned distillation method (Context Forcing) to reach 24 FPS 720p generation with long-term geometric consistency.

title: Native and Compact Structured Latents for 3D Generation
summary: The paper introduces O-Voxel, a sparse voxel representation encoding geometry (Flexible Dual Grid) and PBR materials, a Sparse Compression VAE (SC-VAE) with 16x spatial downsampling, and ~4B-parameter flow-matching DiT models for image-to-3D asset generation (per Sections 3.1-3.3).

title: TurboDiffusion: Accelerating Video Diffusion Models by 100-200 Times
summary: An inference-acceleration framework for pretrained video diffusion models (Wan family) combining SageAttention2++ low-bit attention, trainable Sparse-Linear Attention (SLA), rCM step distillation, and W8A8 block-wise INT8 quantization, achieving 100-200x end-to-end speedup on a single RTX 5090 (per paper Sections 1.1-1.3, 2).

title: DataFlow: An LLM-Driven Framework for Unified Data Preparation and Workflow Automation in the Era of Data-Centric AI
summary: DataFlow is a system-level LLM-driven data preparation framework with ~200 composable operators, six domain pipelines (text, math, code, Text-to-SQL, agentic RAG, knowledge extraction), and a DataFlow-Agent that translates natural-language intent into verified executable pipelines. It is a data-pipeline framework, not a neural architecture.

title: SAM Audio: Segment Anything in Audio
summary: A foundation model for promptable audio source separation that unifies text, visual, and temporal span prompting in a single flow-matching diffusion transformer operating in a DAC-VAE latent space, jointly generating target and residual stems, plus a new benchmark and reference-free judge model (paraphrase of Sections 1 and 3).

title: Nemotron 3 Nano: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning
summary: A 31.6B-parameter (3.2B active) MoE hybrid Mamba-2/Grouped-Query-Attention language model pretrained on 25T tokens, post-trained with SFT, multi-environment RLVR, and RLHF with a generative reward model, then FP8-quantized, achieving strong agentic/reasoning accuracy and up to 3.3x higher inference throughput than comparable open models.

title: MAI-UI Technical Report: Real-World Centric Foundation GUI Agents
summary: A family of Qwen3-VL-based GUI agents (2B–235B-A22B) trained via SFT plus online GRPO RL in containerized Android environments, with agent-user interaction (ask_user), MCP tool calls (mcp_call), a self-evolving trajectory data pipeline, and a device-cloud collaboration system with a local monitor agent.

title: Recursive Language Models
summary: The paper proposes RLMs, an inference-time scaffold that treats an arbitrarily long prompt as an external REPL variable, letting an LLM programmatically inspect, decompose, and recursively sub-call itself over prompt snippets, plus a small post-training recipe (RLM-Qwen3-8B) distilled from larger-model RLM trajectories.

title: Youtu-Agent: Scaling Agent Productivity with Automated Generation and Hybrid Policy Optimization
summary: A modular LLM-agent framework (per paper Sections 2.1-2.4) with YAML-based configuration, two automated generation paradigms (Workflow and Meta-Agent), a training-free experience-accumulation module (Training-free GRPO), and a scalable/stable RL training pipeline integrated with Agent-Lightning/VeRL.

title: Let It Flow: Agentic Crafting on Rock and Roll, Building the ROME Model within an Open Agentic Learning Ecosystem
summary: The paper introduces ALE, an end-to-end agentic LLM ecosystem (ROLL RL training framework, ROCK sandbox environment engine, iFlow CLI agent framework), and ROME, a 30B-activated-3B Qwen3-MoE-based agent model trained via continual pre-training, two-stage SFT with error/context masking, and a novel chunk-level RL algorithm (IPA). It also releases Terminal Bench Pro. This is a systems and post-training report, not a novel architecture.

title: EverMemOS: A Self-Organizing Memory Operating System for Structured Long-Horizon Reasoning
summary: A three-phase LLM memory lifecycle (Episodic Trace Formation into MemCells, Semantic Consolidation into MemScenes plus user profiles, and Reconstructive Recollection via agentic hybrid retrieval with sufficiency checks) that outperforms flat memory baselines on LoCoMo, LongMemEval, and PersonaMem-v2.

title: NitroGen: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Gaming Agents
summary: NitroGen is a vision-action foundation model trained by behavior cloning with flow matching on 40,000 hours of gameplay videos from 1,000+ games, using automatically extracted gamepad action labels from input-overlay videos, plus a multi-game Gymnasium benchmark; fine-tuning from pre-trained weights improves task success up to 52% relative over from-scratch training (paper Sections 1-3).

title: SimpleMem: Efficient Lifelong Memory for LLM Agents
summary: A three-stage LLM-agent memory framework (Semantic Structured Compression, Online Semantic Synthesis, Intent-Aware Retrieval Planning) that compresses dialogue into indexed memory units and adaptively retrieves them, improving F1 and token efficiency on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S (Section 2, Section 3).

title: LTX-2: Efficient Joint Audio-Visual Foundation Model
summary: An open-source text-to-audio+video diffusion foundation model using an asymmetric dual-stream DiT (14B video / 5B audio) coupled by bidirectional audio-visual cross-attention with 1D temporal RoPE, cross-modality AdaLN, Gemma3-based text conditioning with thinking tokens, a compact stereo audio VAE, and modality-aware classifier-free guidance.

title: ImLoc: Revisiting Visual Localization with Image-based Representation
summary: A 2D image-based visual localization pipeline that stores posed RGB images augmented with precomputed dense depth maps, uses image retrieval plus dense matching (RoMa) to build 2D-3D correspondences, and estimates 6-DoF pose with a GPU-accelerated LO-RANSAC + PnP, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy with flexible accuracy/memory trade-offs.

title: Conditional Memory via Scalable Lookup: A New Axis of Sparsity for Large Language Models
summary: The paper proposes Engram, a conditional-memory module that augments a MoE Transformer with hashed N-gram embedding lookups (O(1) retrieval), context-aware gating, and a depthwise causal convolution, and derives a U-shaped sparsity-allocation law between MoE experts and memory tables, showing iso-parameter/iso-FLOPs gains over pure MoE baselines (Sections 1-4).

title: HeartMuLa: A Family of Open Sourced Music Foundation Models
summary: An open-source music foundation model family: HeartCodec (12.5 Hz RVQ music tokenizer with flow-matching decoder), HeartMuLa (hierarchical global/local LLM song generator with lyrics/tag/reference-audio conditioning and four-stage training incl. DPO), plus HeartCLAP (audio-text alignment) and HeartTranscriptor (music ASR).

title: Terminal-Bench: Benchmarking Agents on Hard, Realistic Tasks in Command Line Interfaces
summary: The paper introduces Terminal-Bench 2.0, a curated benchmark of 89 hard, realistic terminal-based tasks with Docker environments, human-written oracle solutions, and outcome-based tests, plus the Harbor harness and Terminus 2 agent; it reports frontier agents resolving under 65% of tasks and provides trajectory- and command-level failure taxonomies. It is an evaluation/benchmark paper, not a model-architecture paper.

title: Qwen3-TTS Technical Report
summary: A family of multilingual, streaming, controllable text-to-speech models built on a dual-track LM over discrete speech tokens, with two custom speech tokenizers (25Hz single-codebook with block-wise DiT detokenizer; 12Hz multi-codebook RVQ with causal ConvNet decoder), trained on 5M+ hours of speech (paraphrased from Abstract and Sections 2-3).

title: C-RADIOv4 (Tech Report)
summary: C-RADIOv4 is an agglomerative vision foundation model trained by multi-teacher distillation from SigLIP2, DINOv3, and SAM3, with shift-equivariant losses, stochastic-resolution training, a balanced summary-token loss, DAMP weight noise, and optional ViTDet windowed attention for efficient high-resolution inference.

title: Masked Depth Modeling for Spatial Perception
summary: Proposes Masked Depth Modeling (MDM): treating naturally missing RGB-D sensor depth as masks, pretraining a ViT-Large encoder with a ConvStack decoder to produce metric, pixel-aligned dense depth (LingBot-Depth), supported by a large curated RGB-D data pipeline.

title: DeepPlanning: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Agentic Planning with Verifiable Constraints
summary: A benchmark of 240 long-horizon agent planning tasks (multi-day travel, multi-product shopping) in offline sandboxes with rule-based verifiable checkers, showing frontier LLM agents fail at global constrained optimization and identifying reasoning and tool-use patterns that improve effectiveness-efficiency trade-offs.

title: A Pragmatic VLA Foundation Model
summary: LingBot-VLA: a vision-language-action foundation model pre-trained on ~20,000 hours of real-world dual-arm robot data using a Mixture-of-Transformers (VLM + flow-matching action expert), with depth-query distillation and an optimized distributed training codebase; demonstrates scaling behavior and state-of-the-art real-world evaluation on GM-100.

title: DeepSeek-OCR 2: Visual Causal Flow
summary: Proposes DeepEncoder V2, which replaces the CLIP module in DeepSeek-OCR with an LLM-style encoder (Qwen2-0.5B) using learnable causal flow queries and a hybrid bidirectional/causal attention mask to dynamically reorder visual tokens before a DeepSeek-3B MoE decoder, improving document OCR performance.

title: Qwen3-ASR Technical Report
summary: A family of LALM-based ASR models (Qwen3-ASR-0.6B/1.7B) posttrained from Qwen3-Omni with a pretrained AuT AED audio encoder, plus Qwen3-ForcedAligner-0.6B, a non-autoregressive LLM slot-filling timestamp predictor trained with non-shifted cross-entropy on [time] slots.

title: Causal World Modeling for Robot Control
summary: The paper (LingBot-VA) proposes an autoregressive diffusion world model for robot manipulation that interleaves video and action tokens in a dual-stream Mixture-of-Transformers, predicts future visual states via flow matching, decodes actions via inverse dynamics, and uses KV-cache, noisy history augmentation, and asynchronous inference for closed-loop control.

title: Kimi K2.5: Visual Agentic Intelligence
summary: A trillion-parameter MoE multimodal agentic model (per the paper) built on Kimi K2, using joint text-vision pre-training with early low-ratio vision fusion, MoonViT-3D native-resolution video/image encoder, zero-vision SFT, joint multimodal RL, and Agent Swarm parallel orchestration trained via PARL with frozen subagents.

title: AutoFigure: Generating and Refining Publication-Ready Scientific Illustrations
summary: The paper introduces FigureBench (3,300 long-form scientific text–figure pairs) and AutoFigure, an inference-only agentic pipeline that converts long scientific text into publication-ready illustrations via three stages: concept extraction into a symbolic SVG/HTML layout, a critique-and-refine loop between designer/critic LLM agents, and aesthetic rendering with an erase-and-correct text post-processing step (paper facts, Sections 1, 3, 4).

title: WideSeek-R1: Exploring Width Scaling for Broad Information Seeking via Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: A lead-agent/subagent multi-agent LLM system (shared Qwen3-4B backbone, isolated contexts, specialized tools) trained end-to-end with a GRPO-based MARL objective (group-normalized multi-agent advantage assignment plus dual-level token/agent advantage reweighting) on a synthesized 20k broad information-seeking dataset, achieving width-scaling gains on WideSearch.

title: DFlash: Block Diffusion for Flash Speculative Decoding
summary: A speculative decoding framework (DFlash) that drafts blocks of tokens in parallel with a lightweight block-diffusion drafter, conditioned on fused hidden features from the frozen target LLM injected as Key/Value entries in every draft layer, achieving up to ~6x lossless speedup over autoregressive decoding and ~2.5x over EAGLE-3.

title: QuantaAlpha: An Evolutionary Framework for LLM-Driven Alpha Mining
summary: An agentic framework that treats each LLM-driven alpha-mining run as a trajectory and improves factors via trajectory-level mutation and crossover, with semantic-consistency, complexity, and redundancy gates; evaluated on CSI 300 with cross-market transfer (paper Sections 1, 4, 5).

title: stable-worldmodel-v1: Reproducible World Modeling Research and Evaluation
summary: The paper introduces stable-worldmodel (SWM), a PyTorch-based library providing a unified World interface over Gymnasium environments, factor-of-variation (FoV) controls, dataset recording, MPC-based planning solvers, and standardized goal-conditioned evaluation, demonstrated by a DINO-WM robustness study on PushT. It is an ecosystem/benchmark paper, not a novel model architecture.

title: Step 3.5 Flash: Open Frontier-Level Intelligence with 11B Active Parameters
summary: A 196B-parameter sparse MoE LLM with 11B active parameters, using interleaved 3:1 sliding-window/full attention with head-wise gated attention, multi-token prediction, Muon-based stable pre-training, and a scalable RL post-training recipe (MIS-PO) for agentic reasoning (per Sections 2, 4, 5 of the paper).

title: SkillsBench: Benchmarking How Well Agent Skills Work Across Diverse Tasks
summary: A paired-evaluation benchmark (87 tasks, 8 domains) measuring whether inference-time Agent Skills help LLM agents, showing curated Skills lift pass rates from 33.9% to 50.5% across 18 model-harness configurations (paper, Abstract and Section 5).

title: GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
summary: GLM-5 is a 744B-parameter (40B active) MoE LLM using DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) introduced via continued pre-training, Muon Split-adapted MLA, parameter-shared MTP, asynchronous agent RL, and multi-stage post-training (SFT, Reasoning/Agentic/General RL, cross-stage distillation) to advance agentic coding. This is a paper summary only; no Zerfoo reproduction is claimed or feasible.

title: World Action Models are Zero-shot Policies
summary: DreamZero is a 14B autoregressive video-diffusion World Action Model that jointly denoises future video frames and robot actions via flow matching, enabling zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks/environments, cross-embodiment transfer from video-only data, and 7Hz real-time control via system/model optimizations (DreamZero-Flash decoupled noise schedules).

title: SAM 3D Body: Robust Full-Body Human Mesh Recovery
summary: A promptable encoder-decoder model for single-image full-body 3D human mesh recovery (body, hands, feet) using the Momentum Human Rig (MHR) parametric mesh, a shared image encoder with separate body and hand decoders, optional 2D keypoint/mask prompts, and a VLM-driven data engine producing ~7M annotated images.

title: dLLM: Simple Diffusion Language Modeling
summary: The paper introduces dLLM, an open-source framework unifying training, inference, and evaluation of diffusion language models (DLMs). It standardizes MDLM and BD3LM trainers behind a modular interface, provides plug-and-play samplers (including Fast-dLLM acceleration), unified lm-evaluation-harness-based evaluation, and recipes/checkpoints converting BERT-style encoders or autoregressive LMs into small DLMs via SFT alone (paper facts, Sections 1,

title: Qwen3-Coder-Next Technical Report
summary: An 80B-total/3B-active hybrid-attention MoE coding-agent LLM trained via large-scale synthesis of verifiable executable coding tasks, staged mid-training, SFT, domain experts, and RL with execution feedback (paper facts).

title: Helios: Real Real-Time Long Video Generation Model
summary: A 14B autoregressive video diffusion transformer (initialized from Wan-2.1-T2V-14B) that achieves minute-scale, real-time (19.5 FPS on one H100) video generation via Unified History Injection (Representation Control + Guidance Attention), Easy Anti-Drifting (Relative RoPE, First-Frame Anchor, Frame-Aware Corrupt), and Deep Compression Flow (Multi-Term Memory Patchification, Pyramid Unified Predictor Corrector, Adversarial Hierarchical Distillatio

title: A recipe for scalable attention-based MLIPs: unlocking long-range accuracy with all-to-all node attention
summary: AllScAIP, an attention-based MLIP combining local neighborhood self-attention with all-to-all node self-attention for long-range interactions, plus optional Legendre Angular Encoding and Euclidean RoPE; ablations show geometric encodings lose value at scale while global node attention remains critical.

title: AutoFigure-Edit: Generating Editable Scientific Illustration
summary: An end-to-end agentic pipeline (per Section 3.1) that converts long-form scientific text plus a reference style image into a fully editable SVG illustration via five stages: style-conditioned raster synthesis, segmentation/structural indexing, asset extraction, VLM-driven SVG template generation with refinement, and asset injection. This is a system/orchestration paper, not a trainable neural architecture.

title: Fish Audio S2 Technical Report
summary: An open-source instruction-following TTS system combining a Dual-AR decoder-only Transformer over RVQ audio tokens, a dual-purpose data pipeline (speech quality model + rich-transcription ASR reused as RL rewards), and GRPO-style multi-reward post-training for controllable, multi-speaker, long-form speech generation.

title: OpenClaw-RL: Train Any Agent Simply by Talking
summary: A server-client RL framework that converts live next-state signals (user replies, tool outputs, environment transitions) from deployed agents into online policy updates, combining scalar evaluative rewards (PRM majority votes) with token-level directive distillation (hint-conditioned self-teacher), stabilized by overlap-guided hint selection and a log-probability-difference clip (paper Sections 1-3).

title: The Python Simulations of Chemistry Framework: 10 years of an open-source quantum chemistry project
summary: A review of ten years of development of the PySCF open-source quantum chemistry package, covering periodic electronic structure infrastructure, DFT, correlated wavefunction methods, AFQMC, excited-state theories, multireference methods, MD, solvation, GPU acceleration (GPU4PySCF), automatic differentiation (PySCFAD), symmetry, and interoperability. The paper contains no neural network architecture, training procedure, or learned model.

title: Attention Residuals
summary: The paper (Kimi Team, technical report) proposes Attention Residuals (AttnRes): replacing fixed unit-weight residual accumulation with softmax attention over preceding layer outputs, driven by a learned per-layer pseudo-query and RMSNorm-normalized keys. Block AttnRes partitions layers into ~8 blocks to cut memory/communication from O(Ld) to O(Nd), with cross-stage caching and a two-phase online-softmax inference strategy; experiments show consis

title: MetaClaw: Just Talk -- An Agent That Meta-Learns and Evolves in the Wild
summary: A continual meta-learning framework for deployed LLM agents that combines gradient-free skill-library evolution from failure trajectories with idle-window RL (GRPO + cloud LoRA) policy updates, coordinated by an opportunistic scheduler and a skill-generation versioning scheme that separates support (failure) from query (post-adaptation) data.

title: MOSS-TTS Technical Report
summary: A speech generation foundation model built on a discrete-token recipe: MOSS-Audio-Tokenizer (causal Transformer RVQ codec, 24 kHz to 12.5 fps, 32 quantizers) plus autoregressive next-token prediction over text and audio tokens, pretrained at scale, released in two variants (Delay-Pattern MOSS-TTS and Global-Latent + Local-Transformer MOSS-TTS-Local-Transformer) supporting voice cloning, duration/pronunciation control, code-switching, and long-for

title: Memento-Skills: Let Agents Design Agents
summary: A frozen-LLM agent system that continually learns by maintaining an evolving library of executable skill files, using a Read-Write Reflective Learning loop (skill retrieval, execution, judging, failure attribution, skill rewriting/discovery) and a behaviour-aligned contrastive skill router trained with multi-positive InfoNCE as one-step offline RL.

title: LeWorldModel: Stable End-to-End Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture from Pixels
summary: LeWM is a JEPA world model trained end-to-end from raw pixels with only two loss terms (next-embedding MSE prediction plus a SIGReg Gaussian anti-collapse regularizer), removing EMA/stop-gradient heuristics and reducing tunable loss hyperparameters to effectively one (lambda).

title: Hyperagents
summary: Introduces hyperagents: self-referential agents combining a task agent and a meta agent in one editable program, instantiated as DGM-Hyperagents (DGM-H), which extends the Darwin Gödel Machine so the self-improvement mechanism itself is modifiable, enabling metacognitive self-improvement across coding, paper review, robotics reward design, and math grading.

title: Speed by Simplicity: A Single-Stream Architecture for Fast Audio-Video Generative Foundation Model
summary: daVinci-MagiHuman: a 15B-parameter single-stream Transformer that jointly denoises video and audio latents with text and image conditioning in one unified token sequence, using only self-attention, plus distillation (DMD-2, 8 steps, no CFG), latent-space super-resolution, and a Turbo VAE decoder for fast audio-video generation. Paper facts only; this is a descriptive summary, not a reproduction claim.

title: Fast and Faithful: Real-Time Verification for Long-Document Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
summary: The paper proposes extending a ModernBERT-style encoder (ModernBERT-base, 149M parameters) to 32K-token context via retrieval-aware YaRN RoPE scaling with retrieval-aware masking and EWC regularization, fine-tuning it as a token-level hallucination detector for RAG responses with response-only supervision and unweighted cross-entropy, and adding lightweight early-exit adapters trained with a 0.5 CE + 0.5 KL distillation objective for configurable

title: MSA: Memory Sparse Attention for Efficient End-to-End Memory Model Scaling to 100M Tokens
summary: MSA is an end-to-end trainable latent-memory framework: a document-based sparse attention with router projectors, chunk-wise KV compression, document-wise RoPE, Memory Parallel tiered inference, and Memory Interleave multi-hop retrieval, achieving linear complexity and <9% degradation from 16K to 100M tokens (per paper, Section 5.2).

title: DataFlex: A Unified Framework for Data-Centric Dynamic Training of Large Language Models
summary: DataFlex (per the paper) is a data-centric dynamic training framework built on LLaMA-Factory that unifies dynamic data selection, domain mixture optimization, and sample reweighting via Select/Mix/Weight trainer abstractions and pluggable components (LESS, NICE, TSDS, DoReMi, ODM, loss-based weighting), with unified embedding/inference/gradient operations and DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 support. This is a training-infrastructure contribution, not a model ar

title: Signals: Trajectory Sampling and Triage for Agentic Interactions
summary: A lightweight, model-call-free signal taxonomy (interaction, execution, environment) for triaging agentic trajectories, plus a sampling framework that raises developer-informative yield (82% vs 54% random on τ-bench) without quality scoring.

title: VOID: Video Object and Interaction Deletion
summary: A video object removal framework that generates physically plausible counterfactual videos: it finetunes a CogVideoX-based diffusion transformer with quadmask conditioning on new Kubric/HUMOTO counterfactual pairs, and uses a VLM at inference to expand object masks into interaction-aware quadmasks and to trigger an optional flow-warped-noise second pass (Sections 3.1-3.6).

title: RAGEN-2: Reasoning Collapse in Agentic RL
summary: The paper identifies 'template collapse' in multi-turn LLM agent RL (reasoning diverse within inputs but input-agnostic across inputs), proposes mutual-information (MI) proxies for diagnosis, explains collapse via a signal-to-noise-ratio (SNR) mechanism, and introduces SNR-Aware Filtering (top-p selection of prompts by within-prompt reward variance) to improve training.

title: SkillClaw: Let Skills Evolve Collectively with Agentic Evolver
summary: A framework (per the paper) where multi-user LLM-agent session trajectories are aggregated as evidence, an LLM-based 'agentic evolver' refines/creates/skips shared skill documents, and a nightly validator accepts only improvements before redeploying skills to all agents. It is a system/prompt-engineering contribution, not a neural architecture or training method.

title: SPEED-Bench: A Unified and Diverse Benchmark for Speculative Decoding
summary: The paper (Sections 1, 4) introduces SPEED-Bench, a benchmark ecosystem for speculative decoding (SD) consisting of a semantically diverse Qualitative data split (880 samples, 11 categories, curated via greedy selection with local swap refinement over text embeddings), a Throughput data split (fixed ISL buckets 1k-32k, three entropy categories, 512 samples each), and a unified measurement framework integrated with production engines (vLLM, Tensor

title: Agent^2 RL-Bench: Can LLM Agents Engineer Agentic RL Post-Training?
summary: The paper introduces a diagnostic benchmark (not a model) that evaluates whether LLM agents can autonomously design, implement, and run RL post-training pipelines for foundation models across six tasks in three levels (static rule-based, static judge-based, closed-loop online RL), with runtime recording and post-hoc summarization for behavioral diagnosis. Paper facts only; no new model architecture or training recipe is proposed.

title: Geometric Context Transformer for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
summary: LingBot-Map is a feed-forward streaming 3D foundation model built on a Geometric Context Transformer (GCT) whose Geometric Context Attention (GCA) splits streaming context into an anchor context, a local pose-reference window, and a compact trajectory memory, enabling near-constant per-frame cost and state-of-the-art streaming pose/depth estimation over very long sequences.

title: Dive into Claude Code: The Design Space of Today's and Future AI Agent Systems
summary: A source-level design-space analysis of the Claude Code agentic coding tool (v2.1.88), identifying five human values, thirteen design principles, a seven-component/five-layer architecture (agent loop, permission system, compaction pipeline, extensibility, subagent delegation, session persistence), and contrasts with OpenClaw and Hermes Agent. This is a qualitative software-architecture study, not a machine-learning model paper.

title: GenericAgent: A Token-Efficient Self-Evolving LLM Agent via Contextual Information Density Maximization (V1.0)
summary: A systems-level LLM agent framework (not a new model architecture) that maximizes contextual information density via four mechanisms: a minimal atomic toolset, hierarchical on-demand memory (L1-L4), reflection-driven self-evolution distilling trajectories into SOPs and code, and layered context truncation/compression.

title: OpenGame: Open Agentic Coding for Games
summary: An open-source agentic framework for end-to-end 2D web game generation from natural-language prompts, combining a six-phase agent workflow, evolving Template/Debug Skills, a domain-specialized code model (GameCoder-27B trained via CPT+SFT+RL), and an execution-based benchmark (OpenGame-Bench).

title: MedSkillAudit: A Domain-Specific Audit Framework for Medical Research Agent Skills
summary: A layered pre-deployment audit framework (skill-auditor@1.0) for medical research agent skills, combining structural veto gates, scientific-integrity veto gates, static ISO 25010-aligned scoring, and dynamic execution scoring (Final Score = 0.4*S_static + 0.6*D_mean), validated against expert review on 75 skills (ICC(2,1)=0.449 vs human baseline 0.300).

title: Memanto: Typed Semantic Memory with Information-Theoretic Retrieval for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: A vector-only agentic memory layer (Memanto) built on Moorcheh's Information Theoretic Search engine, featuring a 13-category typed memory schema, conflict resolution, temporal versioning, and zero-ingestion-cost retrieval, achieving 89.8% on LongMemEval and 87.1% on LoCoMo via a five-stage ablation showing recall expansion dominates over architectural complexity.

title: GLM-5V-Turbo: Toward a Native Foundation Model for Multimodal Agents
summary: A native multimodal agentic foundation model combining a new CogViT vision encoder, Multimodal Multi-Token Prediction (MMTP) with a learnable visual placeholder token, joint vision-language pretraining/SFT, and large-scale multi-task multimodal RL over 30+ task categories, plus an expanded multimodal toolchain and agent-framework integration (paraphrase of Sections 1-3).

title: MiniCPM-o 4.5: Towards Real-Time Full-Duplex Omni-Modal Interaction
summary: A 9B end-to-end omni-modal LLM (MiniCPM-o 4.5) with the Omni-Flow framework that aligns visual, audio, and output streams on a shared temporal axis, enabling real-time full-duplex (simultaneous perceive-and-speak) and proactive interaction, plus Time-Aligned Interleaving (TAIL) for timely speech generation.

title: ARIS: Autonomous Research via Adversarial Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: ARIS is an LLM-agent research harness (not a neural model) that coordinates autonomous ML research via cross-model adversarial executor/reviewer collaboration, a three-stage evidence-to-claim audit cascade, Markdown-defined skills, a persistent research wiki, and a prototype meta-optimization loop.

title: Awaking Spatial Intelligence in Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation
summary: JoyAI-Image couples a spatially enhanced MLLM (Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct base) with a 16B-parameter dual-stream MMDiT and Wan-2.1-VAE to unify image understanding, text-to-image generation, and instruction-based editing, using spatially grounded data engines (OpenSpatial, 3D-driven spatial editing data), multi-stage training, and RL post-training to strengthen spatial intelligence.

title: SenseNova-U1: Unifying Multimodal Understanding and Generation with NEO-unify Architecture
summary: A native unified multimodal model (SenseNova-U1) built on NEO-unify that operates directly on pixels and words without pretrained vision encoders or VAEs, using a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone with a near-lossless 32x patch visual interface, joint autoregressive text loss and pixel-space flow matching, trained in progressive stages (8B dense and 30B-A3B MoE variants).

title: LongLive-2.0: An NVFP4 Parallel Infrastructure for Long Video Generation
summary: A system co-designing NVFP4 quantization with sequence-parallel autoregressive training (Balanced SP) and inference (W4A4, quantized KV cache, async VAE decoding) to fine-tune a bidirectional diffusion model (Wan2.2-TI2V-5B) into a long, multi-shot, real-time AR video generator, plus LoRA-based few-step DMD distillation.

title: AutoResearchClaw: Self-Reinforcing Autonomous Research with Human-AI Collaboration
summary: A 23-stage multi-agent autonomous research pipeline (per Section 3.1) combining structured multi-agent debate, self-healing execution with Pivot/Refine decisions, verifiable result reporting, human-in-the-loop collaboration, and cross-run evolution; evaluated on ARC-Bench (Section 4.1). This is an agentic system, not a trainable neural architecture.

title: HRM-Text: Efficient Pretraining Beyond Scaling
summary: The paper proposes HRM-Text, a dual-timescale hierarchical recurrent language model (slow H-module, fast L-module) stabilized by MagicNorm and warmup deep credit assignment, pretrained from scratch on instruction-response pairs with a response-only NLL objective and PrefixLM masking, achieving competitive benchmark scores with ~100-900x fewer tokens and 96-432x less compute than 2-7B open baselines (per Section 1 and Section 3.3).

title: SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills
summary: SkillOpt treats an agent's natural-language skill document as a trainable external state: a frozen target model executes tasks, a separate optimizer model converts scored rollouts into bounded add/delete/replace text edits, and a held-out validation gate accepts only strictly improving candidates, with a textual learning-rate budget, rejected-edit buffer, and epoch-wise slow/meta update (Section 3, 'Extracted text block 115'–'Extracted text block

title: SIA: Self Improving AI with Harness & Weight Updates
summary: A self-improving loop in which a Feedback-Agent alternately updates a task-specific agent's scaffold (harness) and its model weights (LoRA via RL: PPO, GRPO, entropic advantage weighting, REINFORCE+KL, best-of-N cloning, DPO), showing combined harness+weight updates beat harness-only across law classification, GPU kernel optimization, and scRNA-seq denoising (per §5, §6).

title: FreeForm: Reduced-Order Deformable Simulation from Particle-Based Skinning Eigenmodes
summary: A mesh-free reduced-order elastodynamics method that parameterizes skinning weights with RKPM and obtains them via generalized eigenanalysis of the elastic-energy Hessian, avoiding per-shape neural-field optimization (paper claims ~40x faster training and lower error than Simplicits).

title: COLLEAGUE.SKILL: Automated AI Skill Generation via Expert Knowledge Distillation
summary: An open-source pipeline (per Sections 3-5) that distills heterogeneous human traces into versioned, inspectable, correctable agent-skill packages (SKILL.md plus dual capability/behavior tracks), with presets for colleague, celebrity, and relationship domains; it is an artifact/workflow system, not a trained neural model.

title: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6: Expanding the Frontier of Document Parsing with Under-Optimized Region Refinement and Progressive Post-Training
summary: The paper upgrades a compact 0.9B document-parsing VLM not via architecture changes but via an under-optimized-region data engine (boundary-fragile, coverage-sparse, unreliable-supervision mining) plus multi-expert consensus labeling and a progressive CPT-SFT-GRPO post-training recipe, reaching 96.33% on OmniDocBench v1.6.

title: Ultralytics YOLO26: Unified Real-Time End-to-End Vision Models
summary: A unified real-time detection family (per the paper) combining a dual-head NMS-free design, DFL removal, and three training techniques (MuSGD optimizer, Progressive Loss reweighting, STAL small-object label assignment), plus task-specific heads for segmentation, pose, OBB, and an open-vocabulary YOLOE-26 extension.

title: JoyAI-VL-Interaction: Real-Time Vision-Language Interaction Intelligence
summary: An 8B vision-first interaction model (built on JoyAI-VL 1.0 / Qwen3-8B + Qwen3-VL ViT) that, per second over a live video stream, learns to speak, stay silent, or delegate to a background model, trained with time-aligned data and a role-weighted SFT loss plus GRPO RL, released with a complete deployable streaming system (ASR/TTS, memory, vLLM serving).

title: VibeThinker-3B: Exploring the Frontier of Verifiable Reasoning in Small Language Models
summary: A 3B dense model post-trained from Qwen2.5-Coder-3B via curriculum SFT, multi-domain verifiable RL (MGPO), Long2Short length-aware reward shaping, offline self-distillation, and Instruct RL, achieving frontier-level verifiable math/code reasoning at small scale.

title: Unlimited OCR Works
summary: Proposes Reference Sliding Window Attention (R-SWA), which lets each decoding token attend to all reference (visual+prompt) prefix tokens plus a fixed causal sliding window of n=128 recent output tokens, keeping the KV cache constant during decoding; applied to a DeepSeek OCR baseline (DeepEncoder + 3B MoE LLM, 500M activated) to enable one-shot multi-page document parsing.

title: Causal Discovery in the Era of Agents
summary: A position paper arguing that LLM agents should assist causal-discovery workflows (data inspection, preprocessing guidance, method recommendation, tool coordination, interpretation) but must never supply edges, orientations, priors, or causal conclusions; instantiated as the causal-learn+ platform around the causal-learn algorithm library, demonstrated on Big Five personality questionnaire data.

title: Securing the AI Agent: A Unified Framework for Multi-Layer Agent Red Teaming
summary: AI-Infra-Guard is an open-source agent-security framework that matches a detection paradigm to each of four attack-surface layers (infrastructure, protocol/tool, agent behavior, model): deterministic rule matching, LLM-driven agentic auditing (including agent-skill supply-chain auditing), multi-turn black-box red teaming, and jailbreak attack-operator enumeration with LLM-as-judge.

title: ABot-World-0: Infinite Interactive World Rollout on a Single Desktop GPU
summary: An action-conditioned video world model (5B parameters) that distills a bidirectional Wan2.2-based video DiT teacher into a causal few-step student via teacher forcing, ODE distillation, and LongForcing, deployed with a co-designed streaming stack (LightVAE, FP8/MXFP DiT, SageAttention2, Fast-RoPE, bounded KV cache) reaching up to 16 FPS 720P on one RTX 5090.

title: GNM Head: A Generative aNthropometric Model of the human head
summary: A holistic parametric 3D head model (3DMM) unifying face, eyeballs, teeth, and tongue in one linear identity/expression space with LBS, plus a dual-CVAE Semantic Sampler mapping demographic/expression categories to model coefficients, and an optimization-based fitting pipeline.

title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
summary: A 2.8T-parameter open Mixture-of-Experts language model (104B activated) with hybrid Kimi Delta Attention plus Gated MLA, Attention Residuals, Stable LatentMoE (16 of 896 experts), native vision, 1M-token context, and multi-domain RL post-training (per Sections 1-4).

title: Mage-VL: An Efficient Codec-Native Streaming Multimodal Foundation Model
summary: A codec-native streaming VLM: Mage-ViT selects motion/residual-salient 16x16 patches from I/P frames (HEVC or DCVC), cutting visual tokens ~75%, paired with a Qwen3-4B decoder and a lightweight event gate (System 1) that triggers a causal LLM (System 2) for proactive streaming responses; trained from scratch on ~560M images and 100M video frames via a five-stage curriculum.

title: LongHorizon-Harness: Advancing Long-Horizon Agents for Real-World Tasks
summary: The paper proposes LongHorizon-Harness, an agent orchestration framework (not a neural model) that reformulates long-horizon LLM-agent execution as explicit task-state management via a Manage-Execute-Audit (MEA) loop: a manager maintains audited task state and picks subtasks, a fresh-context executor performs them, and a read-only auditor verifies environment changes before state updates. title: JoyAI-Video-Edit: Real-Time Open-Ended Video Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
summary: A 16B autoregressive diffusion framework (Sec. 3.1) for real-time streaming video editing, combining chunk-wise causal adaptation with sliding-window attention (Sec. 4.1), Source-Anchored Distribution Matching Distillation for two-step generation (Sec. 4.2), and Long-Horizon Autoregressive Distillation (Sec. 4.3), achieving ~30 FPS 720p editing on a B200 GPU (Sec. 5).

title: MatrAIx: Simulating the World with 8.3 Billion Persona Agents
summary: An end-to-end simulated-user evaluation infrastructure: Persona 8B (8.3B persona records under a 1,290-dimensional categorical schema, with a 1M coreset), a Playground with four environments (Survey, AI Chatbot, Web, App), and 1,010 application tasks; validated via 18,189 trials and a 400-trial persona-adherence study (91.5%).

title: LLMRouter: Unified Infrastructure for Developing, Evaluating, and Deploying LLM Routers
summary: The paper unifies LLM routing as a sequential decision process with five components (context encoder, model encoder, scoring function, decision rule, learning signal), builds an automated supervision/evaluation pipeline and the xRouteBench benchmark, and releases an open-source library implementing 16+ routers across single-turn, multi-turn, and personalized families (Section 1; Section 2).

title: BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning with Recurrent Latent Reasoning
summary: BDH-CQ combines in-context learning via a recurrent memory updated by demonstrations with iterative latent-space reasoning (no verbalized chain of thought), reaching 29.5% pass@2 on public ARC-AGI-1 at a computed $0.00070/task with a 150M-parameter model (Section 5).

title: GigaBrain-0.7: Scaling Embodied Foundation Models to Emergent Capabilities with a Three-System Architecture
summary: An embodied foundation-model system (per Section 4, Fig. 6) that couples a PaliGemma2-based VLM (System 2), a PaliGemma2 + 0.5B Action Expert Mixture-of-Transformers VLA (System 1), and a GigaWorld-1-based world value model (System 3), pretrained one-stage on 37k+ hours of heterogeneous robot data with flow-matching continuous actions, Soft Knowledge Insulation, and world-model-conditioned post-training plus offline/online RL.

title: FreeToken: Efficient Edge-Native MoE Serving with Bandwidth-Adaptive Execution
summary: FreeToken is an edge-native serving system (not a new model) for MoE LLMs on consumer hardware. It combines full-layer double-buffered prefill loading, semantic-anchor recurrent-state checkpoints, a shared LRU GPU expert cache, a bandwidth-derived q* policy splitting decode cache misses between PCIe cache fills and in-place CPU expert execution, and elastic runtime VRAM reconfiguration (Sections 3-4).

title: AutoResearch: Insight In, Hallucination Out
summary: A two-stage autonomous research system (per Section 2) that grounds idea generation in evolving research signals plus a domain knowledge base, and grounds idea execution in evidence-based verification before accepting research claims; evaluated on RSICD retrieval, a matrix-multiplication validation task, and three Kaggle benchmarks.

title: Apodex 1.1: Scaling Agentic Intelligence for Complex Work
summary: A technical report describing Apodex 1.1, a general-purpose agentic model and execution stack that scales 'working capability' via Environment Scaling (file/search/code worlds) and Agentic Coordination Scaling (Agent Team, task boards, asymmetric verification), supported by AgentOS, unified SFT, and PIVOT-RL agentic RL. This is a system report, not a trainable numeric-classification architecture.

title: Long-Horizon Audio-Visual Generation for Persistent Stories and Interactive Worlds
summary: JoyAI-Echo-1.5: a unified audio-visual generation system with a long-video variant (composable cross-shot audio-visual memory with speech-filtered voice cues and separated RoPE regions) and a world-model variant (calibrated metric 6-DoF camera-trajectory conditioning via UCPE), converted from a bidirectional multi-step diffusion backbone into a causal few-step generator via teacher forcing and short/long-horizon Self-Gradient Forcing with DMD, pl

title: Prime Agent: A Self-Improving RLM Harness
summary: An open-source agent harness (not a model architecture) that combines persistent REPL execution, recursive subagents, direct agent-to-agent messaging, Continual Harness state (prompts/memories/skills/subagent specs), and long-horizon controls to let a fixed LLM manage information and test-time compute; it reports large benchmark gains (e.g., ARC-AGI-3 RHAE 30%→95.5%).

title: Beyond Data Scaling: Representation-Centric Continued Pre-training for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: The paper proposes VLAct, a representation-centric continued pre-training recipe for VLA models: starting from a pretrained VLM (Qwen3-VL-4B), it preserves the VLM prior via shallow-layer protection and caption-data mixing, avoids single-head over-specialization via multi-head continuous action co-supervision (OFT, PI, GR00T), and shares action semantics across embodiments via a partially unified action layout with masked inactive dimensions and

title: Miles v0.1: Production-Level Post-Training
summary: A full-stack, production system for frontier-scale post-training (RL, LoRA RL, on-policy distillation, SFT, true-on-policy alignment, diffusion RL) built on SGLang rollout engines, Megatron-LM/FSDP trainers, and three weight-synchronization transports, emphasizing token-exact trajectories, numerical fidelity, and verified coverage.
